notes.title: Version 1.2 Update
notes.content:
It's been a little while, but we're back with one more release, [b]Version 1.2[/b]! It contains a new Survival Map, three new Quickplay Maps, some difficulty tweaks, and numerous fixes. Read on the full notes!

[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]General[/b][/h1][list]
[*]Lines drawn with Ctrl-click now matches the player color. 
[/list]

[h1][b]Campaign[/b][/h1][list]
[*]Campaign Co-op added HP multiplier reduced from 25% to 20%. 
[/list]

[h1][b]Survival[/b][/h1][list]
[*]Added a new Co-op Survival map, [b]Big Islands[/b], that allows for an unlimited loadout, along with featuring Islands that have Generators and Aura Towers. 
[*]Increased Survival progression points for clearing 5 waves from 5 to 6. 
[*]Increased Survival progression points for killing a Boss from 6 to 10. 
[*]Nerfed Big Islands difficulty quite a bit. 
[*]Adjusted Two Sides so the first 30 waves are a bit more manageable. 
[*]Adjusted HP scaling further to make more builds viable across all maps. 
[*]Adjusted some of the more problematic waves in End Game Survival. 
[*]You now gain ADDs slower on all maps in waves 60+. 
[/list]

[h1][b]Quickplay[/b][/h1][list]
[*]Added a new Beginner map, [b]End Lines[/b].  
[*]Added a new Intermediate map called [b]Outer Rim[/b]. 
[*]Added a new Advanced map called [b]Ultimatum[/b]. 
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Balance[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]Axons[/b][/h2][list]
[*]Creator Boss spawns spawns per unit type reduced from 6 to 5, and spacing increased from 1.5 to 2 seconds(adjusted due to the HP multiplier fix) 
[*]Advanced Repairer heal reduced from 100 to 75. 
[*]Booster ability speed reduced from 280% to 270%. 
[*]Disruptor base HP reduced from 160 to 150.
[*]Linked Squdron healing cooldown increased from 1s to 1.5s.  
[*]Marauder base HP reduced from 200 to 190. 
[*]Medivac base HP reduced from 100 to 90. 
[*]Replicant score increased from 1 to 2. 
[*]Replicator and Carrier cooldown increased from 7.5s to 9s. 
[*]Replicator and Carrier spawn limit reduced from 6 to 4. 
[*]Reverser score increased from 12 to 20. 
[*]Vanguard base HP reduced from 250 to 240. 
[/list]

[h2][b]Defenses [/b][/h2]

[b]Artillery[/b][list]
[*]U3 damage reduced from 13 to 12. 
[/list]
[b]Duplicator[/b][list]
[*]Duration reduced from 14 to 13. U1 duration reduced from 18 to 17. 
[*]U3 damage multiplier reduced from 225% to 200%. 
[/list]
[b]Energy Saw[/b][list]
[*]Added another damage stage. 
[/list]
[b]EMP Gatling[/b][list]
[*]Damage increased from 2 to 3. 
[*]EMP duration applied per attack increased from 1.2s to 1.5s. 
[/list]
[b]EMP Mine[/b][list]
[*]Cooldown reduced from 20s to 16s. 
[*]Damage increased from 20 to 30. 
[*]U2 damage increased from 40 to 50. 
[/list]
[b]Gravity Driver[/b][list]
[*]U2 Slow reduced from 60% to 50%. 
[/list]
[b]Gravity Generator[/b][list]
[*]Base slow increased from 35% to 40%. 
[*]U1 EMP duration increased from 3s to 5s.
[/list]
[b]Network[/b][list]
[*]Reduced cost from 125 to 110. 
[*]Base damage reduced from 8 to 7. 
[*]Reduced base damage cap from 20 to 15. 
[*]Reduced U2 Slow from 3% to 2% per upgrade. 
[/list]
[b]Plasmathrower[/b][list]
[*]Increased cooldown from 2 to 3 seconds. 
[*]Increased damage of U2 and U3 from 15 to 16. 
[*]U1 reworked: 
 -- Old: Range increased by 1. 
 -- New: Cooldown reduced by 1. 
 -- Damage increased from 16 to 18. 
[/list]
[b]Target Marker[/b][list]
[*]Damage multiplier increased from 25% to 30%. 
[*]Damage cap for the base trap and U1 reduced from 1500 to 600. 
[*]U1 Slow reduced from 40% to 30%. 
[*]Removed the damage cap from U2 and U3.
[/list]
[h2][b]Overloads[/b][/h2][list]
[*]Nuke AoE increased from 3 to 3.5. 
[*]EMP Blast Duration increased from 7s to 8s. 
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Fixes[/b][/h1][list]
[*]Fixed an issue where Chain Overload applied to Blockers.
[*]Fixed an issue where Axons could cross removed Architect bridges due to Temporal Mine.
[*]Fixed an issue where the Creator Boss' spawned Axons didn't take the current HP multiplier into account.
[*]Fixed an issue where the "The Collector" achievement wasn't working at all. 
[*]Fixed an issue where you could receive an upgrade for a Defense you just removed in wave 30 of Survival. 
[*]Fixed an issue where Axon warning messages were popping up in replays. 
[*]Fixed an issue with Omega spawning beacons on invalid platforms on specific maps. 
[*]Fixed an issue where you could place down more ADDs than you had with fast inputs in Multiplayer, resulting in a negative amount. 
[*]Fixed an issue where you were given the wrong Overloads after loading a Co-op save. 
[*]Fixed potential causes of desync with Discharge Blaster and Seeker Drone. 
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]New Project[/b][/h2]
With the release of [b]Version 1.2[/b], new content and feature development ends on [b]Axon TD: Uprising[/b]. We are eternally grateful for all the support you've given us! 

As for Element Studios, we're now heads down on a new project. It will be some time before we can share any information on it. We're excited to share more when we're ready!

notes.title: Map-shifting mech RTS game Axon TD Uprising adds new PvP mode
notes.content:
Adapting your plans to suit the environment is fundamental to many of the best RTS games, but in Axon TD: Uprising you're capable of shifting the very map itself to optimize your base. The mech-based tower defense game has earned itself a very positive Steam user score through its rewarding strategy and blend of modes, with 88% of player reviews recommending it. Now, developer Element Studios is introducing a much-requested new competitive multiplayer mode, allowing you to go head-to-head with real players or skirmish against bots in semi-randomized battles to prove your skills.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Version 1.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
At long last, [b]Version 1.1[/b] has arrived! Its major features include [b]PvP Mode, Skins, & Stats Profile[/b]. And as per usual, it comes with a bevy of balance, fixes, and other updates. Check out our video overview for the quick rundown, and below is our full notes!

[previewyoutube=S9IiiuS4Ydg;full][/previewyoutube]
[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]General[/b][/h1][list]
[*]Added [b]PvP Mode[/b]![list]
[*]Is played in 1v1. 
[*]You start with 30 lives and 3 pre-selected Defenses and see who can survive the longest, or who has the most lives left when the game ends. 
[*]You can also play it with the same random loadout, or a completely random loadout for both of you. 
[*]You can send Axons at your opponent. This costs Credits. The quality of Axons you can send increases as you send more.  
[*]If your sent Axons are killed, your Credits are refunded during the wave. If they leak on the opposing side, those Credits are lost. 
[*]If you leak, you get free spawns. These do not contribute to upgrading your Axons. 
[*]This mode features 4 different maps and has 4 wave lists that it randomizes between. 
[*]Various Defenses have had their base costs adjusted for this mode to be more viable. 
 -- Note: You can play this mode solo by starting a lobby with only one player. The opposing player will be replaced by a bot.
[/list]
[*]Added 3 Skins for each Defense. You unlock them by completing achievements. 
[*]Added a Profile page! This can be accessed from the top-right corner in any menu (click your name or portrait). You can view your stats, achievements, and equip tower skins from here.
[*]Added the ability to draw lines on the grid by holding down Ctrl + Left-click. 
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Balance[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]EMP Rework[/b][/h2]
EMP no longer completely shuts down Axon abilities. It instead reduces their effectiveness by 50%. 

[b]Affected Axons[/b][list]
[*]Repairer: Reduces healing amount to 16 + 0.75%. 
[*]Spectre: Revives with 37.5% HP. 
[*]Cloaker: Duration reduced to 1.5 seconds. 
[*]Infector: Duration reduced to 2 seconds. 
[*]Protector: Damage reduction reduced to 20%. 
[*]Regenerator: Healing reduced to 2 + 0.25%. 
[*]Adv. Reparier: Healing reduced to 50 + 0.75%. 
[*]Replicator: Replicant HP is reduced to 50%. 
[*]Teleporter: Tiles teleported reduced to 3. 
[*]Architect: Duration reduced to 3 seconds. 
[*]Carrier: Hover Jet HP is reduced to 50%. 
[*]Colossus: Takes 50% damage from the front. 
[*]Disruptor: Attack speed reduction reduced to 12.5%. 
[*]Mass Cloaker: Duration reduced to 1.5 seconds. 
[*]Mass Teleporter: Tiles teleported reduced to 1.5. 
[*]Medivac: Reduces healing amount to 22.5 + 0.75%. 
[*]Overcharge Tank: Boost reduced to 160%. 
[*]Reverser: Temporal time reduced to 1.5 seconds. 
[*]Scarab: Nano Scarabs spawn with 50% HP. 
[*]Scarab Lord: Scarabs spawn with 50% HP. 
[*]Linked Squadron: Reduces healing amount to 10 + 0.25%.
[*]Supply Tank: Reduces healing amount to 2.5 + 0.25%. 
[*]Vanguard: Taunt duration reduced to 3.
[/list][b]Unaffected Axons[/b][list]
[*]Berserker
[*]Scout
[*]Sentinel
[*]Nano Scarab
[*]Squadron
[*]Transport
[*]Booster
[*]Hover Jet
[*]Juggernaut
[*]Replicant
[*]Skipper
[*]Avenger Squadron
[*]Adv. Transport
[*]Lifter
[*]Marauder
[*]Purger
[/list]
[h2][b]Survival[/b][/h2][list]
[*]Lowered HP multipliers across the board. 
[*]Added the ability to remove a Defense from your loadout at wave 30. 
[*]Adjusted waves 18 and 19 on Blank Canvas to stand out a little bit less in terms of difficulty. 
[/list]
[h2][b]Axons[/b][/h2][list]
[*]Marauder base HP reduced from 210 to 200. 
[*]Reverser base HP reduced from 160 to 150. 
[*]Reverser ability cooldown increased from 10 to 12s. 
[/list]
[h2][b]Defenses[/b][/h2]
[b]Arc Reactor[/b][list]
[*]Global Upgrade no longer increases bounce range. 
[*]U3 damage reduced from 18 to 16. 
[*]U3 bounce damage multiplier reduced from 1.35 to 1.3. 
[/list]
[b]Artillery[/b][list]
[*]Impact damage increased from 8 to 9. 
[/list]
[b]Axon Factory[/b][list]
[*]Global Upgrade EMP duration increased from 5 to 6. 
[/list]
[b]Catapult Mine[/b][list]
[*]Range increased by 1. 
[/list]
[b]Cryo Beam[/b][list]
[*]Base damage increased from 9 to 10.
[*]U1 damage increased from 5 to 6.  
[/list]
[b]Drilling Laser[/b][list]
[*]U3 upgrade cost increased from 25 to 30. 
[*]U3 AoE damage increment per second increased from 4 to 4.5. 
[/list]
[b]Duplicator[/b][list]
[*]Duration increased from 12 to 14s. 
[*]U1 duration increased from 15 to 18s.
[/list]
[b]Electron Launcher[/b][list]
[*]U2 EMP duration increased from 1 to 2s.  
[/list]
[b]EMP Gatling[/b][list]
[*]EMP Max duration increased from 4 to 6s. 
[*]EMP duration applied per shot increased from 0.75 to 1.2s. 
[/list]
[b]EMP Mine[/b][list]
[*]Now deals 20 damage when triggered. 
[*]U2 damage increased from 30 to 40. 
[/list]
[b]Energy Saw[/b][list]
[*]Base damage increased from 6 to 7. 
[/list]
[b]Frag Hammer[/b][list]
[*]Base damage increased from 90 to 100. 
[*]U3 damage increased from 45 to 55. 
[/list]
[b]Inertia Blaster[/b][list]
[*]Base damage increased from 8 to 10. 
[*]Range increased by 0.5. 
[*]U3 Power cost increased from 25 to 30. 
[*]U3 no longer loses damage per shot, it is now per kill.
[/list]
[b]Link Blaster[/b][list]
[*]Base damage increased from 10 to 12. 
[*]U3 damage increased from 12 to 14.
[/list]
[b]Network[/b][list]
[*]U3 Credit Cap per wave reduced from 36 to 30. 
[*]U3 Credit Cap increase per U3 Network tower reduced from 6 to 5. 
[*]U3 no longer generates Credits from Squadron units. 
[*]Global Upgrade reworked. Every 2 Network towers in the chain, up to 8, now increases the base damage by 1 and cap by 1. 
[/list]
[b]Plasmathrower[/b] [list]
[*]U2 and U3 damage increased from 14 to 15. 
[*]Global Upgrade damage bonus against Armor reduced from 250% to 200%. 
[/list]
[b]Plasma Cannon[/b][list]
[*]U2 EMP duration increased from 5 to 6s.
[/list]
[b]Plasma Vent[/b][list]
[*]U3 Power cost increased from 25 to 30. 
[*]U3 now has a damage cap of 12 damage per second. 
[/list]
[b]Reaper[/b][list]
[*]U3 upgrade cost increased from 25 to 30. 
[*]U3 base damage increased from 20 to 24. 
[*]Global Upgrade EMP duration increased from 3 to 4s.
[/list]
[b]Seeker Drone[/b][list]
[*]U2 stun duration reduced from 2 to 1.5s. 
[/list]
[b]Target Marker[/b][list]
[*]Maximum damage cap reduced from 2000 to 1500. 
[/list]
[h2][b]Overloads[/b][/h2][list]
[*]Boost Range now increases range by 1, but is active for the entire wave. 
[*]Hypercharge duration increased from 6 to 8s.
[*]EMP Blast Duration increased from 6 to 7s. 
[*]Nuke base damage increased from 60 to 70. 
[*]Radiation Cloud DoT damage increased from 6 to 7.
[*]Zeus Cannon Damage ratio increased from 20% to 25%. 
[*]Zeus Cannon Overload Tech bonus increased from 20% to 25%. 
[/list]
[h2][b]Techs[/b][/h2][list]
[*][b]Scaling Economics reworked[/b] and has been reenabled in Survival: 
 -- [b]Old[/b]: Placing down a Defense reduces the Credit cost of the next Defense of the same type, up to a cap of 6. 
 -- [b]New[/b]: When placing down a Defense, reduces the Credit cost of the next Defense of the same type within the same wave by 3. Up to a cap of 12 Costs reset every wave.
[*][b]Feedback Loop reworked[/b] and has been reenabled in Survival: 
 -- [b]Old[/b]: Gain 1 Power for each upgraded Defense, up to a cap of 10 per wave.
 -- [b]New[/b]: If you did not sell this wave, gain 3 power for each Defense you upgraded at the end of the wave. Up to a cap of 12.
[*][b]Cheaper Traps reworked[/b] and has been reenabled in Survival:
 -- [b]Old[/b]: Reduces the Credit cost of traps by 4. 
 -- [b]New[/b]: When placing down a Trap or Mine, each adjacent Trap or Mine of a different type reduces the Credit Cost by 3.
[*][b]Just a Scratch reworked[/b] and has been reenabeld in Survival: 
 -- [b]Old[/b]: Axons take 10 damage when they spawn in. 
 -- [b]New[/b]: Axons take 10% additional damage within 5 range of the entrance.
[*][b]Bonus Sell Charges[/b] reworked and has been reenabled in Survival: 
 -- [b]Old[/b]: Gain 2 extra Sell Charges each wave. 
 -- [b]New[/b]: Gain an extra Sell Charge and 10 Credits when leaking.
[*][b]Trap Master reworked[/b] and has been reenabled in Survival: 
 -- [b]Old[/b]: Reduce Trap and Mine upgrade costs by 5%. 
 -- [b]New[/b]: If a Trap or Mine has been active on the field for 5 waves, reduce its Upgrade Costs by 5 Power.
[*][b]Elite Killers reworked[/b] and has been reenabled in Survival: 
 -- [b]Old[/b]: +1 Credits when an upgraded Tower gets a kill, up to a cap of 30 per wave. 
 -- [b]New[/b]: If you didn't Sell this wave, each Defense you upgrade gains +10% Damage for the duration of the wave.
[*][b]Blocker Exchange reworked[/b] and has been reenabled in Survival: 
 -- [b]Old[/b]: +1 Blocker when you sell a Tower, Can only trigger once per wave. 
 -- [b]New[/b]: When a Blocker is consumed, gain +8 Power. Can only trigger once per wave.
[i]Note: Other Techs that consume Blockers are pre-requisites for this Tech showing up in Survival.[/i]
[*][b]Sentinel reworked[/b] and has been reenabled in Survival: 
 -- [b]Old[/b]: +2 Credits per unupgraded Tower kill. Up to a cap of 30 per wave. 
 -- [b]New[/b]: Every 5th kill from an unupgraded Tower gives +2 Credits, up to a cap of 20 per wave.[list]
[*][i]Note: This means that any one tower needs to score 5 kills individually to trigger the bonus once. Also, for Network, this doesn't count if ANY of the Network Towers in the chain are upgraded.[/i]
[/list][/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Audio[/b][/h2][list]
[*]Added a new music track to the game. 
[*]Updated most of the music tracks in the game. 
[*]Added a sound effect for the contextual ping in Multiplayer
[/list]
[h2][b]Visuals[/b][/h2][list]
[*]Each manufacturer now has a unique fade-in animation when built
[*]Improved Start/Exit Portal visuals
[*]Teleport Portals now show up as yellow and have a teleport visual
[*]On Leak visual updated
[*]Updated colorizations on several Defense upgrades, including Pulseray, EMP Gatling, 
[*]Frag Hammer jet trail improved
[*]Link Blaster U2 now has a cable glow to connected Towers
[/list]
[h1][b]Fixes[/b][/h1][list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the Backtrack Overload would end prematurely if cast shortly after a path change took place.
[*]Fixed an issue where the Plasmathrower Global Upgrade wasn't working. 
[*]Fixed an issue where Hypercharge only worked on the first attack on Frag Hammer. 
[*]Fixed an issue where Portable Generator U1 was listing range instead of AoE. 
[*]Fixed an issue in Co-op where some Techs weren't cleared properly and would persist into the next game session when pressing continue.
[*]Fixed an issue where the Sniper Global Upgrade ricochet could bounce to cloaked units. 
[*]Electron Launcher's range can now be buffed past its Global Upgrade cap. 
[*]Fixed an issue where Axons that couldn't be EMP'd triggered EMP Mines.
[*]Fixed an issue where the game could freeze if you had spawners/splitters on maps with a checkpoint or teleporter.
[*]Fixed an issue with the total damage graph.
[*]Fixed a tooltip error in regards to Portable Generator's Credit cost cap.
[*]Fixed an issue where the "Feedback Loop" Tech was granted as soon as it was picked up. 
[*]Fixed an issue where Duplicator clones did not get affected by adjacency buffs. 
[*]Fixed an issue where Scarabs, Replicators, Carriers and Transport units would not get the HP multiplier applied to them after being spawned.
[*]Fixed the Game Over stats overlapping the Multiplayer chat window.  
[*]Fixed an issue where Astrosys' "create a tile under the placed Defense" Tech didn't allow for placing anything else on it after the tower that created it was sold. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the Astrosys Tile Tech allowed you to place tiles outside of the available play area. 
[*]Fixed an issue where some waves on Two Sides only spawned on one side. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the localization string for the Two Sides map in Survival was incorrect after switching language. 
[*]Fixed an issue where Nuclear U3's debuff indication didn't track past portals. 
[*]Fixed the Zeus Cannon Overload Tech not affecting the HP percentage value.
[*]Fixed an issue where the Reverser warning message wouldn't pop up properly. 
[*]Fixed Reverser not listing its "healing" mechanic in its description. 
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Soundtrack Released![/b][/h1]
Lastly, you can now buy the official soundtrack! It contains 20 tracks, by our composer [b]Nick DeJohn[/b]. As noted in our patch notes, every track has received a mastering pass, making the music truly shine. Check it out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3431320/Axon_TD_Uprising_Soundtrack/

[hr][/hr]
That's it for [b]Version 1.1[/b]! We hope you enjoy the PvP Mode, as well as the many other additions to the game. If you're looking for strategies and players, you can always join [url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]our Discord[/url]. Let us know what you think of it!

notes.title: 1.1 Preview - Profile & Skins
notes.content:
We're just under two weeks out from [b]Version 1.1[/b], which contains:[list]
[*]PvP
[*]Profile
[*]Skins
[/list]Today, we're giving you a quick preview of the latter two!

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Profile[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/56af926687d7e2d42e57b39c0c815294d4cdf992.jpg[/img][i]Turns out the devs lack any stats! We're just ghosts.[/i]

Need more stats in your life? Behold, for we have all the stats! Your level is in the top-left corner, which is based on the number of [b]Achievements[/b] you've completed.

On the bottom are three tabs. This one is the [b]Game Stats[/b] tab. Next to it is your [b]Achievements[/b], which is the same menu as before, just bundled into the [b]Profile[/b]. And the last tab is...

[h2][b]Skins[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/1888e3e79d580a639cfa9f254835ab8f2e322b36.jpg[/img][i]Unlocking is done per Defense, as opposed to per skin.[/i]

Every Defense in the game now has [b]3 Skins[/b]! Don't want all-yellow [b]MegaCorp[/b] Defenses? Now mix and match per Defense at will!

For every 2 Achievements you achieve, you get an Unlock Point. Select a Defense, and you'll have all the Skin options for that Defense! There is no pay-to-unlock for Skins.

Here's a couple examples:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/64188ef928aa1edf18f26ee91d56e58e98a88aea.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/7118c9d8e84ea799a2fa135e6ee4ca56c27160df.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Public Alpha[/b][/h2]
Reminder, you can check out everything in 1.1 early, as soon as right now! We've updated the Alpha a considerable amount in the past weeks, refining PvP Mode, doing final balance tweaks, and more! To try it out:[list]
[*]Right-click Axon TD: Uprising in your game library
[*]Select Properties
[*]Select Betas
[*]From the Beta Participation dropdown menu, select "alpha - Public testing"
[*]You'll then have access to the Version 1.1.alphas![/list]
Let us know what you think of it on [url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]our Discord[/url] in the #axon-alpha channel.

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Release Date[/b][/h2]
We're almost there! Version 1.1 releases on Friday, January 24th! Look forward to a video overview with our patch notes as well.

notes.title: PvP Alpha & Version 1.1 Release Date
notes.content:
[h2][b]Version 1.1[/b][/h2]
First up, release date is moving from December to [u]January 24th[/u]. However, included in this update will be:[list]
[*]PvP Mode
[*]Player Profile
[*]Skins[list]
[*]These will be unlocked through in-game means, not paid[/list][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/b519c0b146d1a638fecf94ca4acde29c5354335b.jpg[/img][i]It's got its own banner![/i]

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]How PvP Works[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Loadout[/b][/h3]
The first thing you'll do in PvP is choose your Loadout. You choose [b]3 Starting Defenses[/b] and [b]2 Overloads[/b]. Note, you can't see what your opponent chooses.[list]
[*]Also, your starting Defenses are Bans. Hypothetically, you and the other player can select the same Defenses, but if you don't, those Defenses will never show up for your opponent throughout the game.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/af255acae9d2d6ae80f6f462a1450f58dd332a65.jpg[/img][i]The Lobby looks a little different...[/i]

[h3][b]Maps[/b][/h3]
The mode currently has three map "layouts". That is, each layout has some degree of randomness:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/3d5ee695a05629e4726e1e973c13ee503519855b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/0f6003f1cfea81e8b4286b7d8f75b58897fb486d.jpg[/img][i]Procedurally generated maps? In Axon TD?[/i]

[h3][b]Sending Axons[/b][/h3]
Like Survival, you'll unlock Defenses over time, though it's a bit expedited, as you'll unlock Defense Upgrades at a faster rate. Maze your side, connect to Generators... and [b]Send Axons[/b]. It's a new button on your UI.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/d83ead54e597fbe14996fb6b499c8d671f2290d6.jpg[/img][i]It's a tech tree for Axons! Are those Bosses at the end?[/i]

How it works is, as you send Axons, two things will happen:[list]
[*]Every two of the same Axon you send will [u]Upgrade[/u] it. The cost is raised by 5 Credits, but it gains Armor, or Mk 2, and eventually even Shields.
[*]Send enough of one Axon in a tree, and you'll [u]Unlock[/u] the next tier of Axons in that branch.
[/list]There's also a default wave order. If you don't send anything, this will spawn. But if you do [b]Send Axons[/b], it'll get mixed into the wave order.


[h3][b]Other Notes[/b][/h3]
We're still working on improving the UI so it tells you these things, but some things to consider:[list]
[*]End-of-wave Rewards are mostly identical.[list]
[*]The Defense Upgrades may be different, but you and the opponent are given the same New Defense choice, Tech choice, and same distribution of Credits/Adds/Power.
[/list][*]You get Credits back for Axons you send when they're destroyed.[list]
[*]However, you [i]don't[/i] get the Credits back when they leak.
[/list][*]Each life you lose gives you a [b]Free Send[/b]. These won't progress the [b]Axon Tech Tree[/b], but you can send something back without cost!
[*]Some Defenses cost less in PvP than other modes. This should help make most builds viable!
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]PvP Alpha[/b][/h2]
To try out the [b]PvP Mode[/b], follow these steps:[list]
[*]Right-click Axon TD: Uprising in your game library
[*]Select Properties
[*]Select Betas
[*]From the Beta Participation dropdown menu, select "alpha - Public testing"
[*]You'll then have access to the Version 1.1.alphas![/list]
Let us know what you think of it on [url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]our Discord[/url] in the #axon-alpha channel. We'll be posting up patch notes soon. You'll also be able to find people to play against in there, so hop on in!

[hr][/hr]
That's it for today's preview! As we get closer to [b]Version 1.1's[/b] release, expect to see a couple more previews detailing other aspects of the patch. In the meantime, we hope you'll try out the alpha, and let us know what you think of the [b]PvP Mode[/b]!

notes.title: Post-Release Content Plans
notes.content:
Just under two weeks ago, we released [b]Version 1.0[/b] of [b]Axon TD: Uprising[/b], and so far, it's been well received! We've seen a good surge of new players and discussions on our forums and [url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]our Discord[/url].

We'd like to share with you a sneak peek of what we're working on. Behold:

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]December Update[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/6ff9418ce1a0aca6b2aa3f08ab6f6483c0b3fd99.jpg[/img]
One of the most requested features we've seen is a [b]PvP Mode[/b] where you can send Axons at the opponent, and that's exactly what we're working on!

You'll choose your Loadout just like [b]Survival[/b]: a couple of Defenses and your Overloads, and then unlock the rest as you go. Additionally, maps will be procedurally generated.

That's all we can share for now. Look forward to a more in-depth preview of the [b]PvP Mode[/b] in [b]November[/b]!

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Q1 Update[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/8bbc1051c233abf4301e7ed62d1c0f597d267d31.jpg[/img]
We're also working on adding [u][b]free[/b][/u] Skins (no microtransactions) to the game, so you'll be able to customize the looks of your Defenses, as well as a profile with detailed stat tracking. And for those of you that enjoy [b]Survival Co-op[/b], there'll be a new map that really tests your mettle.

[hr][/hr]
And of course, on each of these updates, expect the usual set of QoL, Fixes, and Balance updates, as well as new Quickplay & Co-op Maps.

Thanks to everyone that's played [b]Axon TD: Uprising[/b] and for all the feedback! We hope you'll enjoy these future updates.

notes.title: Version 1.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
At long last, Version 1.0 is here! Every part of the game has received love, from revised maps and missions, to Survival, to Boss Mode, and of course, Chapter 5 is here. You can now play the Campaign out to completion - and in Co-op! Read on for the full patch notes.

[hr][/hr]
[b][h1]General[/h1][/b][list]
[*]Added localization for Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Spanish, Japanese and Korean. 
[*]Added a new Boss, [b]Omega[/b]
 -- Spawns 3 beacons every wave in random positions on the unlocked grid that persist through waves. Each one reduces your Defenses' damage until destroyed.  
[*]Added a new Overload, [b]Backtrack[/b]. 
 -- Forces the Axons to walk in the opposite direction for 6s. Axons can still cast abilities while under this effect. 
 -- [b]Overload Tech[/b]: Increases the duration to 9s. 
[*]Added a new Overload, [b]Radiation Cloud[/b].
 -- Deploys a radioactive cloud in a 5x5 area around one of your Defenses for 10 seconds. Axons within the area take damage and all healing received is instead taken as damage.
 -- [b]Overload Tech[/b]: Radiation cloud duration increased to 15 seconds.
[*]Added 11 new achievements.
 -- Clear Chapter 5 of the Campaign
 -- Complete all optional objectives in the campaign. 
 -- Clear the fifth Boss in the Campaign on Hard.
 -- Clear the sixth Boss in the Campaign on Hard.
 -- Clear Survival "Two Sides" on Normal
 -- Clear Survival "Two Sides" on Hard
 -- Complete a map with Boss Mode enabled. 
 -- Complete any Quickplay or Co-op map on Hard difficulty with Chaos, Rush Mode and Boss Mode enabled. 
 -- Unlock 8 Global Defense Upgrades in one game. 
 -- Complete all Co-op maps.
 -- Unlock all 40 Global Defense Upgrades at least once at any point.
[*]Improvements have been made to super ultra wide screen support. 
[*]Added the ability to disable Replay creation and Leaderboard submission. This does not work in Co-op. 
[*]There's now a button for switching player perspective in Co-op replays. 
[*]Your difficulty selection is now saved between sessions. 
[*]Checkpoints no longer disappear for minor version updates. 
[*]You now get a warning when a Boss is about to spawn, both as pop-up on the side of your screen and an icon above the spawn it's coming from. They're also part of the wave preview. 
[*]Added a warning pop-up for Carriers. 
[*]The game now displays the name of the current map/mission you're playing and the current difficulty when you pause. 
[*]Tower selection UI has been adjusted a little so that the Global Upgrade button is no longer outside of it. 
[*]Defenses now display a buff percentage on their damage increases. 
[*]Your Defenses now have a kill counter.
[*]You can now see the Axons' stats when selected.
[*]The Codex has been updated with a new look. 
[*]Adjusted the UI in various menus to make it more consistent and user-friendly.
[*]Adjusted the minimap zoom a little bit. 
[*]Updated the in-game Credits to include more of our wonderful contributors. 
[*][b]Map Editor[/b]: Your level will now be autosaved in a separate file every 15 minutes. 
[*][b]Map Editor[/b]: Added the ability to place Blockers. 
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[b][h1]Campaign[/h1][/b][list]
[*]Chapter 5 has been added. Play out the epic conclusion to the story on Mega-451 with Patricia and Omni!
[*]The Campaign can now be played in Co-op. 
[*]The entire Campaign has been updated to provide more of a challenge in the current balance sandbox, including changes to wave compositions, level layouts, the Tech Tree and the end of wave rewards. 
[*]All the cutscenes have been updated with voice acting, SFX and music. 
[*]You can now resume a Campaign mission from Checkpoints that are saved every wave. 
[*]Added a pop-up dialogue for selecting your difficulty before launching into the first mission. 
[*]Added optional objectives to Chapter 4. 
[*]Every Tech now has a name in the Tech Tree. 
[/list]

[b][h1]Quickplay[/h1][/b][list]
[*]Added Boss Mode!
 -- This is a new modifier that increases the difficulty of any given map with different predetermined Bosses. The Bosses give additional score. 
[*]Adjusted the map layouts to varying degrees of the following maps: 
 -- Matrix
 -- Comms Center
 -- Exodus
 -- Midnight
 -- Relic
 -- Arrival
 -- Contingency
 -- Duality
 -- Foundry 07
 -- Crows's Nest
 -- Fort Terra
 -- Quarantine Zone
 -- Distraction
 -- Network Relay
 -- Intersection
[*]As a result, the thumbnails have been updated. 
[*]Adjusted wave lists to varying degrees of the following maps: 
 -- Fragments
 -- Matrix
 -- Comms Center
 -- Exodus
 -- Vault 110
 -- Midnight
 -- Relic
 -- Arrival
 -- Contingency
 -- Duality
 -- Foundry 07
 -- Crows's Nest
 -- Fort Terra
 -- Quarantine Zone
 -- Lost Sectors
 -- Distraction
 -- Network Relay
 -- Interwoven
 -- Obstruction
 -- Intersection
[/list]

[b][h1]Co-op[/h1][/b][list]
[*]Added Boss Mode!
 -- This is a new modifier that increases the difficulty of any given map with different predetermined Bosses. The Bosses give additional score. 
[*]Adjusted the map layouts to varying degrees of the following maps: 
 -- Across
 -- Approach
 -- Axon Crossing
 -- Lanes
 -- Last Stand
 -- Quadrants
 -- Reach
 -- Redirection
 -- Scattered
 -- Tower
 -- Trident
 -- Triforge
 -- Twister
 -- Two Fronts 
[*]As a result, thumbnails have been updated
[*]All maps have had their wave lists adjusted to various degrees. 
[*]There's now a message indicating that resources will be scaled to player count when you have a map selected with a higher player count than you have players in the lobby. 
[*]Someone leaving a Co-op lobby now unreadies the host. 
[*]Added the ability to return to lobby from within a Co-op session. 
[*]You can now open the menu while you're on the "waiting for other player" screen. 
[/list]

[b][h1]Survival[/h1][/b][list]
[*]Added a new Survival map, [b]Two Sides[/b]. 
 -- Manage two platforms at once. 
 -- In this map, your loadout isn't limited to 8 Defenses. 
[*]The Upgrade Menu has been renamed to "Meta Techs" and has been reorganized horizontally. 
[*]Added 8 new [b]Meta Techs[/b]:
 -- [b]Path Manipulation[/b]: Every 10 waves, you get an extra end of wave choice, allowing you to choose between 4 ADDs, 2 Recycles, or 2 ADDs and 2 Blockers. 
 -- [b]Resource Conversion[/b]: Every 10 waves, gain the ability to exchange your Credits and Power. Power has twice the value of Credits. Your current highest resource according to this ratio gets converted to the other.  
 -- [b]Corrosion[/b]: Damage over time effects total damage increased by 10%. 
 -- [b]Armor Breaker[/b]: Breaking the Armor of an Axon stuns them for 1.5 seconds.
 -- [b]Restrictive Policies[/b]: Gain the ability to remove another Defense and Tech from the End of Wave reward pool. 
 -- [b]Adaptive[/b]: Gain 3 free rerolls to use at any point.
 -- [b]Mega Vex[/b]: Damage-dealing MegaCorp and Vex Defenses costing 75 Credits or less gain +1 base damage on every 15th kill, up to a cap of 4. 
 -- [b]New Astro[/b]: +1 base damage for Seeker Drone, EMP Gatling, Cryo Beam and Radiation Vent. +2 base damage for Inertia Blaster and Artillery.
[*]The end of wave reward item is no longer associated with a specific resource. In other words, the Tech doesn't always come with the power choice anymore. 
 -- As a result, the Power choice value is no longer relatively reduced. 
[*]Adjusted the Platform maps to feature Omega in the end waves.
[*]Reduced the baseline end of wave Credit reward by 10 on all single player Survival maps.  
[*]Various adjustments have been made to the all the single player Survival wave lists.

[*]Widened the playable grid in Co-op [b]Divider[/b] a tad due to the fix where you can no longer place at the edge of the map making it feel a little restrictive.

[*]Upgrade points earned per Boss killed increased from 4 to 6.

[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[b][h1]Balance[/h1][/b]

[*]Stage transition time increased from 3.5 to 4s.

[*]U3 cooldown increased from 5 to 6s. 
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0 Preview - Boss Mode
notes.content:
In just under [u]2 Weeks[/u], we're releasing [b]Version 1.0[/b] for [b]Axon TD: Uprising's Official Release[/b]! We've got one last preview for you all, as we show off [b]Boss Mode[/b] and some [b]Campaign Updates[/b].

[hr][/hr]
[b][h2]Boss Mode[/h2][/b]
Quickplay has a new mode that adds Bosses! Every few waves, a Boss will spawn. Depending on the map, you'll get a different Boss. Every single Quickplay and Co-op map has been given some much-needed updates as well.

You can also turn on Boss Mode in Co-op. And yes, multiple Bosses can spawn at the same time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/24681abdad59cb1d130f01f8f1257cd92f00bb55.jpg[/img][i]Now there are two of them![/i]

[hr][/hr]
[b][h2]Campaign Updates[/h2][/b]
Since the Campaign's original release, the balance of the game has been updated numerous times, making it a bit too easy. We've gone through each mission and tweaked the balance. Hard Difficulty should actually be a consistent challenge throughout the Campaign.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/588faa9e5546ecf4dcd3b56857081f26deb3e854.jpg[/img][i]That's pretty chaotic for one mission.[/i]

Chapter 4 has received Optional Objectives, and Chapter 5 will have them out the gate. The Tech Tree has also been updated. In particular, each Tree is still powerful, but in order to get good gains out of the Resources and Expansion trees, it requires more point investment and tree advancement.

Oh, and as a little teaser for Chapter 5, we've updated OMEGA's design. It's no longer a big green skull.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/80cdf1dab736872794bb9987691d19b7807a0e4b.jpg[/img][i]You can bet [b]OMEGA[/b] will show up in-game as a boss.[/i]

[hr][/hr]
[b][h2]1.0 Alpha[/h2][/b]
We've been working on it more, with tons of fixes and the most refined the balance has ever been! Every Quickplay and Co-op map has received some updates. There's two new Overloads (visuals still pending). And more![list]
[*]Right-click Axon TD: Uprising in your game library
[*]Select Properties
[*]Select Betas
[*]From the Beta Participation dropdown menu, select "alpha - Public testing"
[/list]
You can read the alpha patch notes on [url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]our Discord[/url].

[hr][/hr]
That's our last preview! Look forward to trying out the full release and finishing the Campaign's Story on [b]Friday, September 27th[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/b21f4c1e9b1240ce0dde30b574805595e1408317.png[/img][i]Also, shout out to the people that have completely broken certain Co-op maps with absurd path lengths. Congrats![/i]

notes.title: 1.0 Preview - Co-op Campaign
notes.content:
We're [u]4 Weeks[/u] away from the [b]Version 1.0 Official Release[/b] of [b]Axon TD: Uprising[/b], and today, we're showing off the [b]Co-op Campaign[/b] feature!

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]How it Works[/b][/h2]

By default, when playing the [b]Campaign[/b], it's Singleplayer. However, you can switch it to Co-op quite easily:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/522c014c3f707ad3c2bfc32787020b15270cdae9.jpg[/img]

And when you host a session, it looks quite familiar:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/a970c70a4383856d8e2e2453ec237cdee7f41fe9.jpg[/img]

You've got your "Make Public" button, and the ability to invite directly. Now,, if you wanted to join a public session yourself:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/337f23ce5cba24c1f243fe72a362f53051261912.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/21455bd6e14127c0874b9196561f32d78e90f079.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/24d1745bc0a449198f7ae66101bbe6ac2a1cdf01.jpg[/img]

And now the two of you can play together! As for how the splitting of things works:[list]
[*]Host chooses the mission.
 -- It is possible for the host to play a mission the other player does not have access to in their own progress.
[*]You each use your own Tech Tree & Loadout.
[*]You each run your own pace for Dialogue & Cutscenes.
[*]In-game, Resources & Rewards are split between each player.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]1.0 Alpha[/b][/h2]

You can even try it out right now in the [b]1.0 Alpha[/b]! To access the alpha:[list]
[*]Right-click Axon TD: Uprising in your game library
[*]Select Properties
[*]Select Betas
[*]From the Beta Participation dropdown menu, select "alpha - Public testing"
[/list]
We're currently on [b]Version 1.0.alpha5[/b]. Some of those experimental [b]Survival[/b] changes we mentioned last time have been rolled back. You can read the alpha patch notes on [url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]our Discord[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/e24a85ab0f6b9fb35002bd2d9f509c6ef9e7bd24.jpg[/img]

[hr][/hr]
That's it for this time! For our next preview, we'll show off a sneak peak of [b]Chapter 5[/b] as well as the new [b]Boss Mode[/b] in [b]Quickplay[/b]!

notes.title: Axon TD is leaving Early Access on September 27th!
notes.content:
[b]Axon TD: Uprising[/b] has an [b]Official Release Date[/b], and it's [b]Friday, September 27th[/b]! That's right, in 6 weeks, [b]Version 1.0[/b] will launch, and it includes the following:[list]
[*]New Survival Map
[*]Chapter 5 of the Campaign
[*]Co-op Campaign
[*]Localization
[/list]We'll reveal the details of the [b]Campaign[/b] stuff closer to release. In the meantime, here's a little preview of the new [b]Survival Map[/b] and changes!

[hr][/hr]
[b][h2]Survival Map: Two Sides[/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/604b6962243d547ffcb1c4fd19a0730e94287b1c.jpg[/img]

It kind of looks like one of our [b]Co-op Survival[/b] maps, doesn't it? However, in this version, you're alone. You need to figure out how to split your Resources and Defenses across both sides. Expands on this map are placed on a grid, and there are several islands you can reach and connect to.

Unlike the [b]Co-op Survival[/b] map, you [i]can[/i] connect these two paths. However, it'll take some time to build up to that point. Good luck!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/0aebb8defd2e6fb26e535bfe9f883d467c173267.jpg[/img][i]It's certainly possible... but is it worth it?[/i]

[hr][/hr]
[b][h2]1.0 Alpha[/h2][/b]
For the time being, the above map isn't testable [i]yet[/i]. However, [b]Version 1.0[/b] comes with some experimental changes to [b]Survival[/b] as a whole. Based on your feedback, we may or may not keep these changes. These changes are:[list]
[*]Tech Rewards are no longer tied to Power. It can be tied with Credits or Adds/Recycles/Blockers.
[*]There is no longer a cap of [b]8 Defenses[/b].
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/a1130c03137c31c6e292f608a329a3e1cd2704dd.jpg[/img][i]Normally, the Loadout would end here. Say, what's that arrow?[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/0dbc4b8d709de38f09be9f6790e155cf86f4454f.jpg[/img][i]In theory, you can get all [b]40 Defenses[/b] in a single run![/i]

[hr][/hr]
There are numerous other changes/fixes/balance adjustments as well. You can read those changes on [url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]our Discord[/url]. To try out the [b]1.0 Alpha[/b], follow these steps:[list]
[*]Right-click Axon TD: Uprising in your game library
[*]Select Properties
[*]Select Betas
[*]From the Beta Participation dropdown menu, select "alpha - Public testing"
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
We'll be dropping another preview in two weeks showing off how [b]Co-op Campaign[/b] will work. In the meantime, we encourage you to try out our experimental [b]Survival[/b] changes!

notes.title: Version 0.6 Patch Notes
notes.content:
The next version is here! [b]Version 0.6[/b] includes New Defenses & Axons, reconnect support for Co-op, new Co-op maps, more Qol, a bunch of balance updates, fixes, and more. Check out the 0.6 Overview for the fancy nutshell; full notes are below!

[previewyoutube=vbNqbiN-oaI;full][/previewyoutube]

[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]New Defenses[/b][/h1]

[h3]New MegaCorp Tower: [b]Discharge Blaster[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/2a076e60163921b2cffc7d1295d44f09bf5fa871.jpg[/img]
Uses a battery to overcharge its attacks. Starts at a low cooldown, but the cooldown increases by 0.05 for every attack, until it hits the upper cap. 
After 3 seconds of not attacking, the cooldown is reduced by 0.1 per second, until it hits the attack speed cap.

[u]Stats[/u]:[list]
[*][b]Cost[/b]: 100
[*][b]Range[/b]: 2
[*][b]Damage[/b]: 18
[*][b]AoE[/b]: 1.5
[*][b]Attack speed[/b]: 2.5 to 0.42
[/list][u]Upgrades[/u]:[list]
[*][b]Upgrade 1[/b]: Stuns all Axons hit for .25 seconds. 
[*][b]Upgrade 2[/b]: While it is attacking and has battery charge left, increase adjacent Towers’ attack speed by 15%. 
[*][b]Upgrade 3[/b]: Damage is doubled, no longer has an AoE. Now prioritizes support units. 
[*][b]Global Upgrade[/b]: The battery recharges twice as fast.
[/list]

[h3]New Vex Industries Tower: [b]Axon Factory[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/57d80d5ac67ab7c7592095f8b3834f5ec3940c4e.jpg[/img]
Spawns a radioactive Replicant that paths from the placement location to the nearest spawn point. Explodes upon collision with an Axon and leaves a pool of radioactive waste on the ground dealing damage per second through Armor & Shields. Pool lasts for 4 seconds. 
Spawned units have a lifespan of 10 seconds, then they self-detonate.

[u]Stats[/u]:[list]
[*][b]Cost[/b]: 100
[*][b]Range[/b]: N/A
[*][b]Damage[/b]: 125 + 8 area damage per second
[*][b]AoE[/b]: 1.5 + 1
[*][b]Cooldown[/b]: 15
[/list][u]Upgrades[/u]:[list]
[*][b]Upgrade 1[/b]: Instead spawns 2 Boosters over 3 seconds before it goes on cooldown. 
[*][b]Upgrade 2[/b]: Radioactive pool lasts longer but deals less damage, and applies a 20% Damage Amp on passing Axons for 3 seconds. 
[*][b]Upgrade 3[/b]: Spawns in a phased out Booster that passes through Axons until it expires, slowing them by 20% for 2 seconds. 
[*][b]Global Upgrade[/b]: Every 15 seconds, EMP an Axon adjacent to the factory for 4 seconds.
[/list]

[h3]New Astrosys Labs Tower: [b]Duplicator[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/f900049cbfb83d8442d5f590f151f1e2da4db16d.jpg[/img]
Transforms into a Tower that can deal damage, dealing 160% of the original tower’s damage.
Once a Tower has been copied, it cannot be copied again for 60 seconds. Transformation lasts 12 seconds.

[u]Stats[/u]:[list]
[*][b]Cost[/b]: 100
[*][b]Range[/b]: 5x5
[*][b]Damage[/b]: N/A
[*][b]AoE[/b]: N/A
[*][b]Cooldown[/b]: 20
[/list][u]Upgrades[/u]:[list]
[*][b]Upgrade 1[/b]: Transformation lasts 3 seconds longer.
[*][b]Upgrade 2[/b]: Increases range of the transformed Tower by 0.5. Does not work with area towers.
[*][b]Upgrade 3[/b]: Transformed Towers costing 75 Credits or less instead deal 225% damage. 
[*][b]Global Upgrade[/b]: Casting an Overload on a Duplicator Tower casts the same Overload again on the same Tower 10 seconds later for free.
[/list]

[h3]New New Frontier Mine: [b]Catapult Mine[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/fbd827d333137d4bc766e30f37b78591055ec1f2.jpg[/img]
Directional Mine. Throws an Axon on the mine 3 tiles in the aimed direction. If it collides with a tower, the Axons are stunned for 0.5 seconds. If they’re thrown towards an empty tile and have less than 10% HP, they fall off the map and are destroyed. Otherwise Axons are slowed by 40% for 3 seconds after landing. 
Cannot throw Colossus, Juggernaut, Vanguard, Marauder or Architect.

[u]Stats[/u]:[list]
[*][b]Cost:[/b] 75
[*][b]Range:[/b] 3
[*][b]Damage:[/b] N/A
[*][b]AoE:[/b] N/A
[*][b]Cooldown:[/b] 20
[/list][u]Upgrades[/u]:[list]
[*][b]Upgrade 1:[/b] Increases throwing distance by 1. 
[*][b]Upgrade 2:[/b] Deals 40 damage in a 1.5 AoE around where the thrown Axon lands. 
[*][b]Upgrade 3:[/b] Temporarily removes Armor and Shields from thrown Axons. Duration of 10 seconds. 
[*][b]Global Upgrade:[/b] Mini-stuns Axons passing under a thrown Axon for 0.2 seconds.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]New Axons[/b][/h1]

[h3]New Axon: [b]Skipper[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/5f354beb875edc6541327313cccfc9fe67f7acbf.jpg[/img]
Ignores Mines and Traps.[list]
[*][b]HP[/b]: 100
[*][b]Move speed[/b]: 1.2
[/list]
[h3]New Axon: [b]Reverser[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/35e94506be74bb0d59772941f29b817883dc626a.jpg[/img]
Starts at the exit and leaks at the entrance. Every 10 seconds, it phases forward, healing all the damage it has taken in the last 3 seconds. If it passes any other Axon, that Axon gets a 100% speed boost for 3 seconds. [list]
[*][b]HP[/b]: 170
[*][b]Move speed[/b]: 1.8
[/list]
[h3]New Axon: [b]Architect[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/156d12e1d8f1437e5caba5c7034c51fb34f906ed.jpg[/img]
Every 15 tiles traveled, the Architect stops where it's at and adds a new temporary tile to the grid for 8 seconds. [list]
[*][b]HP[/b]: 250
[*][b]Move speed[/b]: 1.2
[/list]
[h3]New Axon: [b]Marauder[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/9984b7b185fec5cda0e3e6d8155f370c306f486c.jpg[/img]
Every 10 seconds, the Marauder goes debuff immune for 4 seconds and gets a 100% move speed boost. [list]
[*][b]HP[/b]: 240
[*][b]Move speed[/b]: 1.2
[/list]
[h3]New Axon Boss: [b]Creator[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/e8e635d252a525072d6666766c607188d416c918.jpg[/img]
Every 10 seconds, it spawns 6 Axons depending on its current stage. [list]
[*]Stage 1: Berserker Mk II
[*]Stage 2: Booster Mk II
[*]Stage 3: Replicator Mk II
[*]Stage 4: Armored Infector Mk II
[*]Stage 5: Shielded Teleporters Mk II
[*]Stage 6: Marauder Mk II
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]General[/b][/h2][list]
[*]Axon TD now supports Steam Rich Presence, displaying your in-game Status in the Steam community. 
[*]Drag-selecting Defenses no longer include Defenses that are unable to target. 
[*]You can now set a targeting priority while having multiple Defenses selected. 
[*]Added the ability to select all Defenses that can target by pressing 'H'.  
[*]Added a Contextual Warning message for when you first encounter Architects and Hover Jets/Carriers. This is to warn newer players about their abilities. 
[*]Adjusted Tutorial mission 3 to include a mention of Recycles and their new functionality of being able to remove Obstacles. 
[*]Adjusted attacking towers to say "attack speed" instead of cooldown. 
[*]In Campaign, you can now rewatch unlocked cutscenes in your Journal. 
[*]EMP is now indicated by a magenta-colored bar on top of the HP bar. 
[*]Axons that are debuff immune now have a distorted HP bar indicator.
[/list]
[h2][b]Co-op[/b][/h2][list]
[*]A new Co-op Survival Map has been added called Big Platforms, based on the Platform map from singleplayer Survival, but without checkpoints.
[*]New 2-player map: [b]Across[/b]. 
[*]New 3-player map: [b]Freehold[/b]. 
[*]New 4-player map: [b]Roundabout[/b]. 
[*]Co-op solo is now played offline. 
[*]Co-op sessions can now be restarted from in-game after passing a vote. 
[*]You can now resume a Co-op game from a checkpoint as long as you don't lose from the Co-op menu.
[*]You can no longer pick up more than one Tower, Upgrade or Tech in one wave in solo Co-op.
[/list]
[h2][b]Survival[/b][/h2][list]
[*]Added 6 new end waves to the wave 30+ list featuring the new Axons. 
[*]Blank Canvas
 -- Reduced the HP multiplier for waves 30+.
 -- Slightly increased the HP multiplier for waves 80+. 
[*]Platform
 -- Reduced the 30+ waves HP scaling. 
 -- Reduced the amount of tiles on the map. 
[*]Each Survival map now has a rotation of 3 Bosses after wave 30 instead of being random. However, the wave 120 Boss will always be either the Goliath or Creator. [list]
[*][b]Blank Canvas[/b]
 – Revenant → Guardian → Iron Centipede → repeat | Final Boss is Goliath. 
[*][b]Islands[/b]
 – Guardian → Iron Centipede → Goliath → repeat | Final Boss is Creator.
[*][b]Platform[/b]
 – Creator → Revenant → Goliath → repeat | Final Boss is Goliath.
[*][b]Divider[/b]
 – Goliath → Revenant → Creator → repeat | Final Boss is Goliath. 
[*][b]Big Platform[/b]
 – Revenant → Guardian → Iron Centipede → repeat | Final Boss is Creator. 
[/list][*]Added descriptions to the Survival maps in the Survival and Lobby menus. 
[/list]
[h2][b]Map Editor[/b][/h2][list]
[*]Added a tutorial video for the Map Editor. 
[*]Added tooltips to most of the value boxes. 
[*]Added the ability to press Tab to cycle through value boxes. 
[*]Made various UI adjustments, most notably in the Axon and Tech selection screens. 
[*]You can now simulate the player count when testing your map. 
[/list]
[h2][b]Visuals[/b][/h2][list]
[*]New death visual
[*]Updated Reaper Tower attack visuals
[*]Updated Seeker Drone Tower attack visuals
[*]Updated Orbital Cannon Tower attack visuals
[*]Updated Plasma Cannon U2 & U3 attack visuals
[*]Added a Debuff Immunity visual for Purger & Lifter
[*]Various tweaks to backgrounds
[/list]
[h2][b]Fixes[/b][/h2][list]
[*]Fixed Bosses giving almost no additional score. 
[*]Fixed an issue where Command Link wasn't buffing the range of Electron Launcher. 
[*]Fixed a visual issue where the Command Link "link" would remain after selling a Tower connected to it. 
[*]Fixed an issue where Mass Driver was hitting twice on every shot. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the Temporal Mine Global Upgrade was triggering multiple times per activation. 
[*]Fixed an issue where Siphon Cannons couldn't target Axons with Seeker Drones attached to them. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the Colossus frontal shield was blocking multiple effects that it wasn't supposed to be blocking.
[*]Fixed an issue with Hover Jet pathing. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the "Place a Tower on a Blocker to gain Credits" Tech was causing your Blocker count to go negative.
[*]Fixed an issue where the UI cost display didn't update on wave reset with the Mega Expansionist Survival Upgrade. 
[*]Fixed an issue causing you to stay connected to Co-op lobbies you had left. 
[*]Fixed an issue in Survival where you could get stuck with only 7 Defenses in your loadout. 
[*]Fixed some Techs accidentally being removed from the Survival Tech pool. 
[*]Fixed Blockers having a target priority setting. 
[*]Fixed an issue where some parts of the descriptions got cut off in the tooltips.
[*]Fixed an issue where the UI got cut off at higher resolutions.
[*]Fixed being able to click a spawn point through UI elements. 
[*]Fixed various issues with Co-op lobbies. 
[*]Fixed various tooltip errors.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Balance[/b][/h2][list]
[*]Added Architect and Lifter to the Smart Targeting support priority list. 
[*]Smart targeting has been updated for single-target towers to more reliably target down high priority support units. 
[*]Defenses on Default targeting will now prioritize Bosses that are close to leaking. 
[*]Drilling Laser now also prioritizes support units. 
[/list]
[h3][b]Axons[/b][/h3][list]
[*]Carrier base HP reduced from 160 to 150. 
[*]Lifter adjusted: 
 -- Now Lifts an Axon for 10 seconds then drops it. Cooldown of 3 seconds. 
 -- Lifters can no longer Lift Medivacs. 
[*]Mass Teleporter:
 -- Now has a max cap of 15 Axons it can teleport at once. 
 -- Cooldown increased from 10s to 12s. 
 [/list]
[h3][b]Defenses[/b][/h3]

[b]Artillery[/b][list]
[*]U3 adjusted
 -- Power cost increased from 25 to 30. 
 -- Damage reduced from 15 to 13. 
 -- Cooldown reduced from 2 to 1.5. 
[/list]
[b]Blast Cannon[/b][list]
[*]U2 Power cost increased from 25 to 30, and slow reduced from 40% to 35%. 
[/list]
[b]Cryo Beam[/b][list]
[*]Slow per stack reduced from 20% to 15%. 
[/list]
[b]Drilling Laser[/b][list]
[*]Range increased from 2.5 to 3. 
[/list]
[b]Electron Launcher[/b][list]
[*]Damage increased by 1 for the base tower and all upgrades. 
[/list]
[b]Energy Saw[/b][list]
[*]Base damage increased from 5 to 6.
[/list]
[b]Frag Hammer[/b][list]
[*]U3 damage reduced from 65 to 50. 
[*]Stun duration reduced from .8s to .7s at base, U3 from .4s to .3s.
[/list]
[b]Gravity Trap[/b][list]
[*]Passive slow now automatically applies to all upgrades.
[*]Passive slow reduced from 25% to 20%. 
[*]U1 stun reduced from 2.5s to 2s. 
[*]Global Upgrade replaced: 
 -- [b]Old[/b]: Increases passive slow rate to 30% and the passive slow applies to all upgrades. 
 -- [b]New[/b]: Increases passive slow rate to 25% and slow linger duration to 2 seconds.
[/list]
[b]Mass Driver[/b][list]
[*]Base damage increased from 60 to 65.
[/list]
[b]Missile Launcher[/b][list]
[*]Base damage increased from 18 to 22. 
[*]U1 damage increased from 13 to 16.
[*]U2 stun duration increased from .5s to .7s. 
[/list]
[b]Nuclear[/b][list]
[*]Repair debuff increased from 35% to 50%. 
[*]Base damage increased from 5 to 6. 
[*]U1 cap increased from 12 to 15. 
[*]U3 Power cost increased from 35 to 40. 
[*]U3 damage increased from 50 over 10s to 64 over 8s. 
[/list]
[b]Orbital Cannon[/b][list]
[*]U2 damage increased from 36 to 38. 
[/list]
[b]Plasmathrower[/b][list]
[*]Now resets its remaining salvo count when not firing continuously.
[/list]
[b]Plasma Cannon[/b][list]
[*]U2 EMP duration increased from 4s to 6s. 
[*]U3 Amp increased from 25% to 30%. 
[/list]
[b]Portable Generator[/b][list]
[*]Base cost reduced from 40 to 30. 
[*]Credit cost now increases by 2 for each Portable Generator you build, with a cap of 50. 
[*]U2 Power Cost increased from 30 to 35. 
[*]Global Upgrade damage bonus reduced from 25% to 20%. 
[/list]
[b]Radiation Vent[/b][list]
[*]Global Upgrade amp per debuff type increased from 3% to 4%. 
[/list]
[b]Siphon Cannon[/b][list]
[*]Global Upgrade replaced: 
 -- [b]Old[/b]: Increases the range of the Siphon Field by 0.5. 
 -- [b]New[/b]: Increases the damage of adjacent Defenses by 15% for 4s when firing. 
[/list]
[b]Temporal Mine[/b][list]
[*]Credit cost increased from 50 to 75. 
[*]Upgrade costs increased from 25 to 30 for all upgrades. 
[*]Global Upgrade damage increased from 75 to 90. 
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]Overloads[/b][/h3][list]
[*]Compound Rounds has been reworked: 
 -- Is now called Shredder. 
 -- Removes Armor and Shields from Axons in an AoE of 3 around it for 10 seconds. 
 -- The Shredder Overload Tech increases the duration of this debuff by 5 seconds. 
[*]Nuke damage reduced from 50 + 10% to 75 + 6%. 
[*]Amplify base Amp reduced from 50% to 40%. 
[/list]
[h3][b]Techs[/b][/h3][list]
[*]Power On Leak Power bonus increased from 10 to 15 in Quickplay and Co-op. 
[*]Wave End ADD now has a minimum wave of 10 and gives an ADD every 3 waves instead of every 2 in Survival. 
 -- [i]Getting this one early pretty much ensured you were good with ADDs for the rest of the game.[/i]
[*]+1 ADDs if you don't pick an ADD from the end of wave reward now has a minimum wave of 20. 
 -- [i]Combined with the Tech above, this resulted in an insane abundance of ADDs.[/i]
[*]Interest per wave reduced from 15% to 10% in Survival. 
 -- [i]Another source of free income that was too easy to just get every wave and fed into itself.[/i]
[*]Global Credit Cost reduction reduced from 10% to 8% in Survival. 
[*]Global Power Cost reduction reduced from 10% to 8% in Survival.
 -- [i]These techs stack up too much in late game Survival.[/i]
[*]The Nuke Overload Tech has been adjusted to instead give +1 AoE. 
 -- [i]The high HP damage in an AoE scaled disproportionally well in late game Survival.[/i]
[*]The Amplify Overload Tech Amp bonus reduced from 25% to 20%. 
 -- [i]This has a very high value in late game Survival.[/i]
[*]+5% Damage for all Defenses for the next 5 waves now has a minimum wave of 10 in Survival.
[*]Deployment Aura no longer deactivates from selling. 
[*][b]Big Spender[/b] reworked: 
 -- [b]Old[/b]: +1 ADD when spending 100 Credits or more in one wave. Can only trigger once per wave. 
 -- [b]New[/b]: +1 ADD at the start of the wave when spending 150 Credits or more without selling.
[*][b]Lone Tower[/b] replaced: 
 -- [b]Old[/b]: +1 ADD when placing a Tower with no adjacent Defenses. Selling deactivates this Tech for the duration of the wave.
 -- [b]New[/b]: Renamed to [b]Hard Materials[/b]: +1 ADD when Recycling an Obstacle. 
[*][b]Sweeper[/b] reworked: 
 -- [b]Old[/b]: +1 Recycle when placing a Defense within 3 range of the exit. Selling deactivates this Tech for the duration of the wave. 
 -- [b]New[/b]: +1 Recycle if you place down a damage dealing Tower within 3 range of the exit during the wave.
[*][b]Buy Low, Sell High[/b] reworked: 
 -- [b]Old[/b]: +10 Credits when selling a Defense costing 50 Credits or less. 
 -- [b]New[/b]: +30 Credits when selling 3 or more Defenses in one wave.
[*][b]Power Build[/b] reworked: 
 -- [b]Old[/b]: +3 Power per adjacent empty tile when placing down your first Defense in a wave. 
 -- [b]New[/b]: -8 Upgrade cost for the first Defense you build this wave. Selling deactivates this Tech for the duration of this wave.
[/list]
[h3][b]Survival Upgrades[/b][/h3][list]
[*]"Mega Kill" reworked: 
 -- Now gives a constant 10% damage bonus to all MegaCorp Defenses that cost 50 Credits or less. 
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
As usual, with a major update that adjusts balance, [b]Leaderboards[/b] have been wiped. Experiment at will with the new Defenses, and look forward to more updates as we near our [b]Official Release[/b]!

notes.title: Final 0.6 Preview - July 26th
notes.content:
Let's start off with the good news: [b]Version 0.6[/b] is releasing next week on [b]Friday, July 26th[/b]! Included in it will be:[list]
[*]New Defenses
[*]New Axons
[*]New Co-op Maps
[*]And the usual fixes, QoL, & Balance
[/list]
With our final preview, we're showing off the last two [b]New Defenses[/b]!

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Duplicator Tower[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/dc245413572ac3dd92052f918f78d62f4fa77130.gif[/img]
[i]Don't mind the off-screen Snipers, I was securing Generators.[/i]

From [b]Astrosys Labs[/b], the [b]Duplicator[/b] is capable of cloning other [b]Towers[/b] within a 5x5 area. This clone has a limited duration but deals increased damage. And with its upgrades, you may be able to increase its damage further or even increase the clone's range!

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Catapult Mine Trap[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/36a6af477c74248fde83ceea1f5b472a5b3b47a4.gif[/img]
[i]I wonder what would happen if it was aimed into the void...[/i]

And from [b]New Frontier[/b], they have a trap capable of launching [b]Axons[/b]! Choose your direction, and launch at will! It won't launch over Towers/Blockers, but it will launch over gaps, at up to 3 range away. And, if their HP is low enough... it is possible to yeet the [b]Axons[/b] into the hole.

[hr][/hr]
That's it for our final preview! Look forward to trying all this out and more in next week's big update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/c9930f4fb59ba999b324b60f90bec6394497eccd.gif[/img]
[i]Relax, these tiles it places are temporary. Wait... Axons can place tiles?[/i]

notes.title: 0.6 Preview #3 & Open Beta
notes.content:
Another preview, another [b]Defense[/b] and [b]Axon[/b] to showcase. And you can try it out right now! See the bottom of the post for details.

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]New Defense: Axon Factory[/b][/h2]
New tower for Vex Industries, this one manufactures its own Replicants and launches them down the path towards the spawn. These Replicants can travel pretty far, and when they reach an Axon, they explode and leave a pool of radioactive waste, dealing a DoT for a short duration.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/589f5dcad5d597ab9a7bba4740de99d1ca13a5a6.gif[/img]
[i]Those Axons seem to be coming from the wrong direction... or are they?[/i]

[h2][b]New Axon: Marauder[/b][/h2]
A bulky bipedal Axon. It periodically leaps up and jets forward. During this time, it has increased speed and ignores debuffs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/6ac2acd2c078cfdeee636122b2bc0349e0a8beb9.gif[/img]
[i]Did it just jump past the other Axons?[/i]

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]0.6 Open Beta[/b][/h2]

Interested in trying the new Defenses out? Follow these steps:[list]
[*]Right-click Axon TD: Uprising in your game library
[*]Select Properties
[*]Select Betas
[*]From the Beta Participation dropdown menu, select "alpha - Public testing"
[/list]
You can find a full list of changes on [url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]our Discord[/url] in the #axon-patch-notes channel. Try it out and let us know what you think of it!

[hr][/hr]
[b]Version 0.6[/b] will be releasing later this month. Full details of what it entails will be shown in our next and last preview, so look forward to it!

notes.title: 0.6 Preview #2 - Discharge Blaster & Reverser
notes.content:
Coming in [b]Version 0.6[/b] is [b]New Defenses & New Axons[/b]! And we're showing off a few of them today!

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Discharge Blaster[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/4476b3113d2895e35c46ff088107e85a1ba23450.gif[/img]

A new tower for [b]MegaCorp[/b], it attacks quickly out the gate but loses charge over time. Break up the wave to give it some time to recharge!

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Reverser[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/0b1db4e2e62436c4dce17b60bd0a8c04898654cb.gif[/img]

It's not a bug. The [b]Reverser[/b] Axon spawns [i]from the exit[/i]. On top of that, it moves faster than normal, can take a beating, and it speeds up Axons it passes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/f1c1397f1d753b4aeda4a663e3a162ba7c8477c6.gif[/img]
[i]It even teleports forward every so often. Is there anything it can't do?[/i]

[hr][/hr]
That's it for today's preview! Next time, look forward to more of our [b]New Defenses & Axons[/b]!

notes.title: Preview #1 of Version 0.6
notes.content:
Over the next month, we'll be dropping little previews for our next patch, [b]Version 0.6[/b]. Check out our mini-showcase below!

[h2][b]New Co-op Survival Map[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/a9804560d60e86caccad2bc983c44ef117c03dc2.png[/img][i]It feels a bit familiar...[/i]

Like our third solo [b]Survival Map[/b], it's a procedurally generated map that's largely filled in. However, instead of checkpoints, two path cross each other. And of course, its difficulty has been cranked up.

[hr][/hr]
We're also in the process of updating some of our VFX:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/c3002e79a246b0c144d25de35caf823805fe2822.gif[/img]
[i]Reaper now looks like it actually shoots something. And explosions are cooler![/i]

Look forward to another preview in the coming weeks! Maybe there'll be a new [b]Defense[/b] or [b]Axon[/b]...

notes.title: Version 0.5.4 - Hotfixes
notes.content:
[h2][b]Fixes[/b][/h2][list]
[*]Fixed the Blocker Nuke Tech causing a null reference error when used in wave breaks.
[*]Fixed building on a Blocker adjacent to a Command Link U1 not counting towards its tower count.
[*]Fixed an argument out of range exception if the player builds a Tower while the Iron Centipede hits a checkpoint.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/112a69930daf44e07fbeba7e7658e8a777b61087.gif[/img]
