notes.title: Version 0.5.3 - Map Editor Update
notes.content:
With [b]Version 0.5[/b], we added a [b]Map Editor[/b] to the game, along with [b]Steam Workshop[/b] support. Today's update, in addition to hotfixes, adds some new features and QoL to the editor.

[b][h2]General[/h2][/b][list]
[*]Co-op Leaderboard submissions will now show the end wave. This is not retroactive. 
[/list]
[b][h2]Map Editor[/h2][/b][list]
[*]Hovering over a custom map now shows a little preview window. 
[*]In any box with a number value, you can now scroll your mousewheel to adjust the value while hovering over the box. 
[*]Added a consolidated Menu for adjusting the grid and level called "Configure Grid", where you can adjust the positioning of your entire level in addition to adjusting the Grid Size. 
[*]Added the ability to "Unlock" tiles, allowing you to place tiles where you can build without the player expanding to them. 
[*]Added the ability to place down upgraded pre-placed Defenses. 
[*]Added the ability to rotate directional towers before placing them down. 
[*]Added the ability to use one of our backgrounds for your level under the "Game Settings" Menu. 
[*]You can now see the HP and move speed of all the Axons in the Axon selection screen. 
[*]You can now see the HP of any given wave, per path and in total. 
[*]Added the ability copy and paste the end of wave rewards. 
[*]There's now a standard template that creates 3 end of wave reward options using our standardized values from Quickplay and Co-op maps. This means 60 Credits = 3 ADDs = 30 Power. 
[*]Added the ability to select "Random Tech" and select up to 30 Techs to be included in the randomization as an end of wave reward. Acquired Techs won't show up in the next wave even if you reuse the same list. 
[*]Added the ability to spawn Bosses. 
[/list]
[b][h2]Fixes[/h2][/b][list]
[*]Fixed an issue where you could prematurely access the first mission in chapter 5, only to be permanently stuck in a loading screen. 
[*]Fixed an issue where you could load checkpoints in Solo Co-op, resulting in a permanent loading screen. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the "You Know Nothing" achievement was triggering prematurely. 
[*]Fixed an issue where Siphon Cannon couldn't target a unit that had been Lifted. 
[*]Fixed an exploit in Survival. 
[*]Fixed an issue with replays related to the random seed. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the distance to the Destination for Axons wasn't calculated correctly after being lifted by Lifter. 
[*]Fixed some audio issues related to ambience and attenuation. 
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.5.1 & 0.5.2 Hotfixes
notes.content:
[h2][b]General[/b][/h2][list]
[*]Recycles have been disabled for use mid-wave. This could be abused to create an endless loop in Survival where you kept forcing Axons to go back and forth. [/list]
[h2][b]Map Editor[/b][/h2][list]
[*]Made the background a bit brighter. [/list]
[h2][b]Fixes[/b][/h2][list]
[*]Fixed an issue where Gravity Generator U2 would not apply the slowing field on adjacent Defenses if they were placed before the upgrade was applied. 
[*]Fixed being able to interact with the UI while the Tutorial videos were playing. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the Campaign would throw a constant error if you had no prior progress. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the first level of Campaign chapter 4 would be unavailable if you had completed chapter 3. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the mission texts in the campaign would show the completed version before you actually had completed it. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the campaign text sometimes would overlap two texts at once. 
[*]Fixed an issue where some mission dialogue wasn't loading. 
[*]Fixed an issue where altering the path in any way would cause an ArgumentOutOfRangeException. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the second Boss on Survival Platform wouldn't have an HP bar. 
[*]Fixed a pathing issue related to pre-placed towers on Rotators. 
[*]Fixed an issue where placing down an Aura Tower in the map editor would throw an error. 
[*]Fixed an issue where if you were playing Solo Co-op, the Tech would be greyed out in the third reward, even if you didn't pick it. 
[*]Fixed a visual error where Linked Squadron would remain linked to parts of the Squadron that had already leaked. 
[*]Fixed a visual error where HP bars wouldn't get hidden when hiding the UI. 
[*]Fixed an issue with the new "Deployment Aura" Tech being disabled if you upgraded the Tower that it was active on. 
[*]Fixed the "Stun on Leak" Tech not working. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the "Use 40 Power in a wave to get an ADD" displayed incorrectly in the in-game popup. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the camera was broken in the Swamp Biome. 
[*]Fixed an issue where leaking and loading a checkpoint would lose you Credits. 
[*]Fixed some icons having incorrect or missing resource overlays. 
[*]Fixed some tooltips. 
[/list]
Also, [b]Axon TD: Uprising[/b] is on sale for 15% off until Sunday, May 19th.

notes.title: Version 0.5 - Map Editor, Chapter 4, 3rd Survival Map
notes.content:
Welcome to [b]Version 0.5[/b]! Contrary to what the version number implies, we are [i]not[/i] only halfway to full release. With this update, we'll have accomplished our [b]Q2 Roadmap Goals[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/c4b90073f42d914525f316373e59db88ad30afae.png[/img][i]Three quarters down, one to go![/i]

In a nutshell, [b]Version 0.5[/b] adds the following:[list]
[*]Map Editor with Workshop Support
[*]Chapter 4 of the Campaign
[*]3rd Survival Map
[*]17 New Achievements
[*]6 New Techs
[*]Hard Difficulty added to Campaign
[*]Balance, QoL, Fixes & more!
[/list]
Read on below for the full patch notes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/12c6a4c32eff4b75a64fc24ce328e14210c67a08.gif[/img]
[i]It's not a realistic map, but it gets the point across. Create at will![/i]

[hr][/hr]
[b][h2]General[/h2][/b][list]
[*]Added the Map Editor and enabled Workshop Support!
 -- This can be accessed from the main menu, and in both Quickplay and Co-op, there's now a submenu that allows you subscribe to and manage your workshop maps.
[*]Recycles can now be used on Obstacles to remove them. Doing so does not give an ADD. The corresponding Tech has been retired. 
 -- Being able to do this completely trivializes some maps, so we've added a new [b]Wall[/b] tile with the designated purpose of separating sections of the map. 
[*]The tutorial missions have been updated, and now have videos attached to them, introducing you to the concept of each mission before you get into it. 
[*]Added more images to the loading screen. 
[*]The Load Checkpoint button in all modes now shows which level and wave you're loading into. 
[*]Checkpoints no longer clear on Game Over. 
[*]A timescale option for 0.5x has been added to Replays.
[*]Tooltips have been updated to prepare for localization down-the-road. In case you spot any errors, let us know.
[*]Boss HP bars have been updated to be on top of the Boss. It will also still display at the top if there is only one Boss. This is to be able to support multiple Bosses. 
[*]Added 17 new Achievements: 
[b]No way out[/b]
[i]Complete the 4th Chapter of the Campaign[/i]
[b]Sightseeing[/b]
[i]Complete an Optional Objective in the Campaign[/i]
[b]Taking advantage[/b]
[i]Complete 5 Optional Objectives in the Campaign[/i]
[b]The harder they fall[/b]
[i]Complete the first Boss mission on Hard difficulty. [/i]
[b]Trojan horse[/b]
[i]Complete the second Boss mission on Hard difficulty. [/i]
[b]Probably not a meatball[/b]
[i]Complete the third Boss mission on Hard difficulty. [/i]
[b]I like trains[/b]
[i]Complete the fourth Boss mission on Hard difficulty. [/i]
[b]Survivor: Platform[/b]
 [i]Finish wave 30 of Survival Platform on Normal difficulty. [/i]
[b]Epic Survivor: Platform[/b]
[i]Finish wave 30 of Survival Platform on Hard difficulty. [/i]
[b]Adaptation[/b]
[i]Complete the “Contingency” Quickplay map on Hard difficulty with Chaos Mode turned on. [/i]
[b]No Distractions[/b]
[i]Complete the “Distraction” Quickplay map without activating any pre-placed Towers.[/i]
[b]Networking[/b]
[i]Complete the “Network Relay” Quickplay map while using at least 10 Network Towers. [/i]
[b]Incorporated[/b]
[i]Beat wave 30 in any Survival with a loadout consisting of only MegaCorp Defenses. [/i]
[b]Red eyes[/b]
[i]Beat wave 30 in any Survival with a loadout consisting of only Vex Industries Defenses. [/i]
[b]Field research[/b]
[i]Beat wave 30 in any Survival with a loadout consisting of only Astrosys Labs Defenses.[/i]
[b]Makeshift solutions[/b]
[i]Beat wave 30 in any Survival with a loadout consisting of only New Frontier Defenses.[/i]
[b]Reshape the World[/b]
[i]Open the Map Editor[/i]
[/list]

[b][h2]New Axons[/h2][/b][list]
[*]Added the "Iron Centipede" Boss!
 -- This Boss is in fact 6 Bosses in one, forming a line hovering above the path, protecting anything passing underneath them from taking damage entirely. All 6 parts are open to damage at the same time, and goes immune whenever one of them is destroyed. 
[*]The "Advanced Transport" Axon has been added to the game. It's tankier than a normal Transport, and on death, it spawns an Avenger Squadron. 
[/list]

[b][h2]Campaign[/h2][/b][list]
[*]Chapter 4 is now available, featuring 8 new missions and continuing the story on Mega-451!
[*]Campaign now features Hard difficulty. 
[*]Campaign Tech Tree has been updated again. In a nutshell:
 -- Numerous techs have been shuffled out.
 -- The first tree, based around Resources, requires more investment and is slightly nerfed overall.
 -- The second tree, based around Expansion, several easily convenient Adds techs were moved towards the right side, requiring more investment.
 -- The third tree, based around Defenses, has more upgrade levels and is generally buffed.
 -- In order to progress properly, you will need to reset your Tech Tree.
[*]Adjusted Mission 19's Story to use VP Stephens instead of Lieutenant Blake.
[/list]

[b][h2]Quickplay[/h2][/b][list]
[*]Updates and various difficulty tweaks to [b]Contingency[/b], [b]Arrival[/b] & [b]Network Relay[/b] to align with the new balance levels.
[*]Added 3 new levels, [b]Midnight[/b], [b]Fort Terra[/b] and [b]Intersection[/b].
[/list]

[b][h2]Survival[/h2][/b][list]
[*]Added the third Survival map, [b]Platform[/b]!
 -- This map is a randomly generated platform with checkpoints and pre-placed Generators and Aura Towers. There are no Expands, and you're given a free ADD every 3 waves. Enjoy manipulating the path to your heart's content!
[*]The Power + Tech choice has had its Power reward dropped by 5 Power across the board. 
[i]Currently, Upgrades, Global Upgrades and Overloads feel like they come for free because Power is too easy to get. This is just moving the needle a little.[/i]
[*]The first 3 wave end rewards now offer 3 Defense choices instead of 2. 
[*]The wave 120 Boss will now always be Goliath, since the other two Bosses mainly support the following waves and are a slog to kill in one wave. Plus, they have no chance of leaking. 
[b]Blank Canvas[/b]
[*]Wave 90+ HP scaling has been slightly increased. 
[b]Survival Islands[/b] 
[*]Now have 2 additional Islands on the outer edges, and will always spawn with
 -- 2 Credit Generators
 -- 2 Power Generators
 -- 2 Damage Aura Towers
 -- 2 Slow Aura Towers
[i]This is to reduce the need for rerolling your start and equalizing all runs a bit more.[/i]
[b]Divider(Co-op)[/b]
[*]Multiple redundant Techs have been removed from the pool. 
[*]HP multiplier increased across the board. 
[*]Boss HPs have been increased across the board. 
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[b][h2]Balance[/h2][/b]

[b][h3]General[/h3][/b][list]
[*]Overload Power cost is now increased by 1 each time you use it within the same wave. Resets each wave.
[*]Shield charges have globally been reduced from 4 to 3. 
[/list]
[b][h3]Axons[/h3][/b][list]
[*][b]Goliath Boss[/b] at wave 30 HP increased from 1200 to 1250 per stage. 
[*][b]Goliath Boss[/b] first stage move speed increased between waves 45 -- 90 in Survival. 
[*][b]Goliath Boss[/b] past wave 90 in Survival move speed rescaled from 0.5 / 0.75 / 1 to 0.6 / 0.8 / 1.

[*][b]Colossus[/b] no longer blocks instances of [b]Nanite Nest[/b], [b]Network[/b] and [b]Seeker Drone[/b] damage regardless of where it's facing.
[*][b]Linked Squadron[/b] healing is now done in intervals instead of continuously. 
[i]This hindered certain towers, like Arc Reactor and Nuclear, from dealing damage to them.[/i]
[*][b]Replicators[/b] and [b]Carriers [/b]now have a max of 6 spawned units out at a time. 
[*][b]Lifter[/b] HP reduced from 120 to 140. 
[*][b]Hover Jet[/b] HP increased from 60 to 70.
[/list]
[b][h3]Defenses[/h3][/b]
[b]Arc Reactor[/b][list]
[*]No longer applies a healing debuff on hit. 
[*]Instead applies a debuff that slows down the recharge rate of Shields by 50% for 6 seconds. 
[*]Cooldown increased from 2.6s to 4s. 
[*]Base damage increased from 18 to 30. 
[*]Base damage lost per bounce increased from -10% to -15%, U3 is unaffected. 
[*]U2 stun duration increased from 0.4s to 0.5s
[*]U3 damage increased from 9 to 18. 
[*]U3 Power cost increased from 30 to 40.[/list]
[b]Blast Cannon[/b][list]
[*]U1 Bonus damage cap reduced from 70% to 50%. 
[i]This one was outdamaging  several other AoE damage options with just a little setup.[/i][/list]
[b]Drilling Laser[/b][list]
[*]Base damage increased from 6 to 10. 
[*]U1 base damage increased from 8 to 12. 
[*]Damage cap increased from 26 to 30. 
[*]U3 AoE reduced from 2 to 1.5.
[*]Global Upgrade damage retention increased from 25% to 30%.[/list]
[b]Electron Launcher[/b][list]
[*]Energy Orb damaging AoE reduced from 2 to 1.5. 
[*]U1 damage reduced from 13 to 12. 
[*]Global Upgrade is now capped to a maximum of 8 range. [/list]
[b]EMP Gatling[/b][list]
[*]Base damage increased from 2 to 3. 
[*]U3 Damage Amp increased from 25% to 30%.[/list]
[b]Gravity Generator[/b][list]
[*]U2 Slow reduced from 35% to 25%. 
[*]U3 replaced:
 -- Old: If there are 3 or less Axons within the Gravity field, apply a bonus slow of 30%.
 -- New: Every 15 seconds, lift an Axon into the air for 6 seconds.
[*]Global Upgrade replaced: 
 -- Old: Deals 4 damage around it every second.
 -- New: If there are 3 or less Axons within the Gravity Field, increase the slow amount by 10%. This also applies to the extra gravity fields of U2.[/list]
[b]Frag Hammer[/b][list]
[*]Damage increased from 90/45 to 100/50. 
[*]Primary tile stun increased from 0.7s to 0.8s.[/list]
[b]Inertia Blaster[/b][list]
[*]Base damage increased from 3 to 8.[/list]
[b]Mass Driver[/b][list]
[*]U2 has been moved to U1.
[*]U1 Damage bonus reduced from 60% to 25%. 
[*]U2 replaced: 
 -- Old: Deals more damage when hitting fewer Axons. 
 -- New: Applies a 20% Damage Amp for 3s. 
[*]Global Upgrade replaced: 
 -- Old: If the Mass Driver hits less than 5 Axons, apply a 20% slow for 3 seconds.
 -- New: Axons above 80% health take an additional 15% damage.[/list]
[b]Network[/b][list]
[*]Range increased by 1. 
[*]Base damage increased from 4 to 5. 
[*]U1 Damage cap increase per upgrade increased from 2 to 3. 
[*]U1 Damage cap increased from 40 to 48. 
[*]U2 Slow per upgrade reduced from 6% to 5%. Cap remains the same.  
[*]U3 Credit gain cap increased from 30 to 36.  
[*]Global Upgrade replaced: 
 -- Old: Reduces the upgrade cost of Astrosys Towers under the beams.
 -- New: Increases the damage cap of the Network by 1 per connected Network tower, up to a cap of 10.[/list]
[b]Nuclear[/b][list]
[*]Credit Cost increased from 100 to 125. 
[*]Base damage increased from 3 to 5. 
[*]Now applies a debuff that reduces healing within the range of Nuclear towers by 35%. 
[*]U1 Damage cap increased from 10 to 12.
[*]U3 Debuff damage increased from 3 to 5 per second. 
[*]U3 now starts dealing its Debuff damage immediately when entering the area of the first Nuclear U3 Tower, rather than when leaving it. [/list]
[b]Orbital Cannon[/b][list]
[*]Base damage increased from 26 to 30. 
[*]U2 damage increased from 32 to 36.[/list]
[b]Plasma Cannon[/b][list]
[*]Base damage increased from 32 to 36. [/list]
[b]Plasmathrower[/b][list]
[*]Now fires for 1.5 seconds, dealing damage every 0.5s, then has a cooldown of 2s. 
[*]Now ignores Shields. 
[*]Base damage increased from 12 to 16. 
[*]U2 damage increased from 6 to 12. 
[*]U3 damage increased from 10 to 12.[/list]
[b]Plasma Saw[/b][list]
[*]Is now called [b]Energy Saw[/b]!
[*]No longer deals Plasma damage. 
[*]U2 now ignores Shields. 
[*]U3 replaced: 
 -- Old: Reduced damage. Applies a Damage amp to all targets within range.
 -- New: If it breaks a Shield, stun the Axon for 0.8 seconds.[/list]
[b]Plasma Vent[/b][list]
[*]Now ignores Shields.[/list]
[b]Radiation Vent[/b][list]
[*]U2 Damage debuff is no longer cleared by Purger, only the Slow.[/list]
[b]Reaper[/b][list]
[*]Damage Cap increased from 30 to 32. 
[*]U3 damage bonus per debuff increased from 25% to 30%.[/list]
[b]Seeker Drone[/b][list]
[*]Axons can now only have one Seeker Drone attached to them. 
[*]Base damage increased from 8 to 9. 
[*]U1 damage cap reduced from 20 to 15. 
[i]In extreme cases, this outdamaged more expensive options by almost 50%.[/i]
[*]U3 damage increased from 5 to 6. 
[*]Global Upgrade damage bonus is now capped to 5(20 tiles in distance). 
[i]This tower was too spammable, and now it can be bumped a bit for general use.[/i][/list]
[b]Siphon Cannon[/b][list]
[*]On default targeting, it will now prioritize Axons within the final 20% of the path.
[*]U3 damaging field now ignores Shields. 
[i]This is to reduce its utility value vs. Shields.[/i][/list]
[b]Target Marker[/b][list]
[*]Now has a stored damage cap of 4000. 
[i]It was disproportionally good in lategame Survival due to tighly packed waves and this is just intended to hit that upper end.[/i]
[*]U1 & U2 upgrade costs increased from 25 to 30.[/list]
[b]Temporal Mine[/b][list]
[*]Axons cannot be teleported by Temporal Mine more than once. 
[*]Cooldown increased from 10s to 15s.
[*]Now uses a small AoE instead of being a direct hit. 
[*]Will now always hit Boosters and Replicants. 
[*]U1 replaced: 
 -- Old: Reduced cooldown when teleporting 3 or more Axons. 
 -- New: Increases AoE. 
[*]U2 Slow AoE increased from 1 to 1.5.
[*]U3 Amp increased from 20% to 25%. 
[*]Global Upgrade replaced: 
 -- Old: Deals 12 damage within 2 AoE of where Axons are teleported. 
 -- New: Deals 75 damage to teleported Axons, ignoring Armor and Shields.[/list]
[b]World Engine[/b][list]
[*]Base damage reduced from 14 to 13. 
[*]U3 damage increased from 11 to 18.
[/list]
[b][h3]Overloads[/h3][/b][list]
[*]Stasis Wave AoE reduced from 3 to 2.
[/list]
[b][h3]Techs[/h3][/b][list]
[*]6 new Techs have been added. 
 -- The first healing support unit(Supply Tank, Repairer, Adv. Repairer or Medivac) that is killed in each wave will blow up, triggering a Nuke around it. 
 -- The first Defense you place down each wave will have a 5x5 Damage Aura applied to it that deals 6 damage per second to anything within it. [i]Selling first deactivates this Tech for the duration of the wave.[/i]
 -- Selling a Defense costing 75 base Credits or less does not consume a Sell charge. (Ignores cost reduction Techs). [i]Can only trigger once per wave. [/i]
 -- Gives 3 Power during the wave for each 20% of the path the Axons progress. 
 -- Axons take 10% more damage while Stunned. 
 -- 50% of your highest resource gets converted to the other. Power is twice the value of Credits. 

[*]"+1 ADDs if you don't have an ADD at the end of the Wave" reworked. 
 -- Now gives an extra ADD when picking up ADDs from the End of Wave Reward. 
[*]"Credit bonus per 10 path length" has been reworked.
 -- Now only takes your longest path into account, making it eligible for multi-path maps.  
[*]Hitting 15 Axons with an Overload no longer gives a Recycle, instead refunds the Overload cost for that use. 
[*]Credits per wave now has a minimum wave of 10 and Credits per wave have been reduced from 16 to 14 in Survival. 
[*]Power per wave now has a minimum wave of 10 and Power per wave have been reduced from 8 to 7 in Survival. 
[i]These two Techs just gave you free income that was pretty high.[/i]
[*]Same Tower Credit Reduction cap reduced from 10 to 8 in Survival. 
[*]Power per adjacent empty tile has been reduced from 3 to 2 in Survival. 
[*]Recycle gives Power bonus reduced from 15 to 10 in Survival. 
[*]Life Refund now has minimum wave of 15, up from 10 in Survival.
[*]Removed the "Unupgraded Tower kills generate Credits per wave" Tech from the Survival Tech pool. 
[*]Credits Generated when Axons pass a Blocker down from 4 to 3 per Blocker. Cap remains the same. 
[*]Power Bonus on Trap and Mine kills no longer has a maximum wave. 
[*]Mine cooldown reduction reduced from 15% to 10%. 
[*]Stun On Leak cooldown increased from 1s to 3s. 
[*]25+ Axons on the field damage increased from 10 to 20. 
[*]Sacrifice Lives to gain Credits and Power bonus increased from 50/25 to 60/30.
[*]Marked Tile now gives another tile every 60 tiles, up from 50. Damage amp reduced from 20% to 10%. 
[*]The following Techs are now deactivated for the duration of the wave if you use a Sell. 
 -- Power On Build
 -- 100 Credits or higher Tower gives ADD
 -- 40 or more Power in a wave gives an ADD
 -- Isolated Tower Gives ADD
 -- Exit Tower Gives a Recycle
[i]This is to prevent these Techs from being abused by just selling and replacing your Defenses each wave.[/i]
[/list]
[b][h3]Survival Upgrades[/h3][/b][list]
[*][b]Tear Down[/b] now gives a Sell every 3 waves, up from every 2. 
[*][b]Planning Ahead[/b] now also grants a Blocker on waves 5, 10 and 15.
[*][b]Resilient[/b] now gives you the life bonus each time you kill a Boss.

[*][b]Tread Lightly[/b] Slow reduced from 10% to 5%. 
[*][b]Bloodthirsty[/b] damage bonus reduced from 10% to 5%. 
[*][b]Freebies[/b] now gives a secondary free Tech at wave 10. 
[*][b]Focus Development[/b] Tech bans increased from 2 to 3. 
[*][b]Loadout Adjustment[/b] Defense bans increased from 1 to 2. 
[*][b]Focus Development[/b] and [b]Loadout Adjustment[/b] no longer reroll the other options when banning a Defense or Tech. 
[*][b]Last Ditch Defense[/b] damage bonus increased from 10% to 15%. 
[*][b]Bargain[/b] now gives an additional free Defense Upgrade.
[*][b]Locked In[/b] no longer gives a free Defense Tech. Instead, reduces the Upgrade Cost on all Defenses of the last type you picked up by 3.
[*][b]Tactical Positioning[/b] damage bonus increased from 1% to 2%, making it easier to trigger. Cap remains the same. 
[*][b]Mega Expansionist[/b] Credit discount reduced from 8 to 6. 
[*][b]Mad Science Power[/b] discount reduced from 4 to 3. 
[*][b]Tactical Upgrade[/b] damage bonus increased from 10% to 15%.
[*][b]Corpo[/b], [b]Mega Expansionist[/b] and [b]Mad Science[/b] are now deactivated for the duration of the wave if you use a Sell. 
[i]This is to prevent these Upgrades from being abused by just selling and replacing your Defenses each wave.[/i]
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[b][h2]Fixes[/h2][/b][list]
[*]Fixed an issue in late game Survival where you would almost exclusively get Recycles in the End of Wave Rewards. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the Stasis Wave Overload was causing a Desync. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the random generation seed was causing a Desync in combination with the Marked Tile Tech. 
[*]Fixed a desync caused by loading a checkpoint. 
[*]Fixed a desync caused by [b]Blast Cannon[/b]. 
[*]Fixed various other minor causes of Desyncs. 
[*]Made some tweaks to the End of Wave Sync Check in Co-op. 
[*]Fixed an issue where Co-op games could get stuck due to Sync Check. 
[*]Fixed an issue where personal Tech activation popups would be shown to all players in Co-op. 
[*]Fixed an issue where you could get Upgrades for your allies' Defenses in Co-op Survival when banning a Tower or Tech. 
[*]Fixed an issue where your rewards would repeat in Co-op Survival. 
[*]Fixed an issue with Survival Co-op replays desyncing when jumping to wave. 
[*]Fixed the "Waves until next expand" tooltip in Survival Co-op being off. 
[*]Fixed being able to spam inputs to build beyond your Credit limit in Co-op. 
[*]Fixed being able to invite someone from a different version of the game to your Co-op lobbies. It'll now give an error popup. 
[*]Fixed an issue where World Engine's max damage wasn't increased by damage buffs. 
[*]Fixed an issue where Nuclear could not benefit from damage buffs. 
[*]Fixed an issue where Siphon Cannon's cooldown could drop below 0. 
[*]Fixed an issue where Command Link was connecting to Portable Generator. 
[*]Fixed multiple instances of damage and debuffs bypassing the [b]Lifter[/b] immunity applied to the lifted unit. 
[*]Fixed an issue where some Axons would take flight without wings. 
[*]Fixed Gravity Generator U2 giving buff indicators on Traps and Mines built next to it. 
[*]Fixed the Expansionist Survival Upgrade not resetting on wave end. 
[*]Fixed being able to select Axons through the UI. 
[*]Fixed an issue where Armor and Shields would reset when hitting a pathing checkpoint.
[*]Fixed an issue where a Tower would remain visible on the minimap after being sold.
[*]Fixed an issue where Overload tooltips were not being updated after picking up the corresponding Overload Techs. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the [b]No Adjacent Tower Bonus[/b] Tech was being deactivated by adjacent pre-placed Towers. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the [b]Life Gambit[/b] tech tooltip always displayed as failed.  
[*]Fixed an issue where anything in the game that "bounces" could bounce to invalid targets. 
[*]Fixed a rare issue where Obstacles didn't spawn in Survival. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the Boss HP was not clearing on death. 
[*]Removed a bunch of Debug messages in the game logging.
[*]Multiple fixes and adjustments to how checkpoints are saved.
[*]Multiple tooltip fixes.
[/list]
As per usual with a bunch of balance updates and fixes, [b]Leaderboards[/b] have been reset.
[hr][/hr]
Lastly, we have a walkthrough of the [b]Map Editor[/b]. It covers the basics, shows you how to set up a few waves, and how to publish.
[previewyoutube=C0ZCmuJstAE;full][/previewyoutube]
[hr][/hr]
That covers it for [b]Version 0.5[/b]! Of course, the [b]Map Editor[/b] isn't finished, and we'll continue to update it while we work on our [b]Q3 Goals[/b]. We hope you enjoy all the new content, making maps, and trying others' maps on the Workshop!

notes.title: Map Editor Preview - Out May 10th

notes.title: Version 0.4.6 Hotfix
notes.content:
Unlike April Fool's Version 0.4.666, the following fixes are actually real.

[h2][b]Fixes[/b][/h2][list]
[*]Fixed a rare bug that would cause Recycle to think a node is invalid.
[*]Fixed EMP Gatling U3 damage amp not working at all.
[*]Fixed another case of the game freezing when hovering over "Waves until next Expand".
[*]Also fixed the "Waves until next Expand" value being inaccurate.
[*]Fixed a visual error where Missile Launcher's missiles were perpendicular to the trail.[list]
[*]Ironically, we only noticed this bug when cranking up its attack rate for the 0.4.666 Hotfix. It served a purpose afterall.
[/list][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/f5850f5e20393aa2777dbddf75861d0464463bf5.gif[/img]
[i]An alternate dialed-down cut of 0.4.666's World Engine. Sadly, this is a little too powerful to make it into the actual game.[/i]

notes.title: April Fool's 0.4.666 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Guess what! Version 0.4 had so many bugs, we found even [i]more[/i] wrong with the game. So this hotfix here should address the remainder of the problems. We also adjusted balance just slightly. Read on below for the full notes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/4a54b8102fcdf7059a427a9abfe2c477991ca4aa.gif[/img]
[i]Missile Launcher wasn't firing enough missiles, so we fixed that.[/i]

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]General[/b][/h2][list]
[*]Due to lack of use, the [b]Builder[/b] has been removed from the game.
[*]Every time a Defense kills an Axon, confetti explodes from it. Time to celebrate!
[*]Placing an Add will require you solve a quick math problem in limited time. Failure to answer in time or getting it wrong will result in Subtracting a random tile in your maze.
[*]Revolutionary Discord Integration added. Every single message from the [url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]Element Studios[/url] server will now appear in the middle of the screen, in every mode. If the server is unable to reach your account because you're offline, your account will receive a VAC ban.
[*]In Co-op, you can no longer send resources to each other. In this feature's place, you have the ability to send Axons to your partners.
[*]In the Campaign, OMEGA has been updated to be a washing machine stuck in the spin circle for all eternity.
[*]Western Mode from Element TD 2 has been added. There is no option to turn it off.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/f2efd0acdb25ed162629729159ebdc246ca3d42c.gif[/img]
[i]Pulseray now perma-stuns Axons. Finally, this tower is useful![/i]

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Axons[/b][/h2]

[b]New Axon: Adaptive[/b][list]
[*]Becomes resistant to your highest damaging Element Damage Type from the previous wave.
[/list][b]Advanced Repairer[/b][list]
[*]On death, repairs the platform itself to its original state, restoring all Recycled Tiles. These are truly advanced tactics!
[/list][b]Avenger Squadron[/b][list]
[*]These are far too expensive to hire and have thus been replaced with bootleg versions: Adventure Squadrons.
[/list][b]Berserker[/b][list]
[*]Each time a fellow Berserker on the field dies, it rages and attacks your Defenses.
[/list][b]Booster[/b][list]
[*]No longer speeds itself up. Attaches to your Defenses, speeding them up by a factor of 10. Any Defense that refuses to move will have its legs ripped from the platform in dramatic slow motion.
[/list][b]Carry[/b][list]
[*]Renamed from Carrier to Carry.
[*]If supported properly, it will lead accrue enough gold to max out its items and lead the Axons to victory.
[/list][b]Cleaner[/b][list]
[*]Renamed from Purger to Cleaner.
[*]Now cleans up all the messes your Defenses and the other Axons made. Great for the environment!
[/list][b]Cloaker[/b][list]
[*]Has been updated to wear an actual cloak. Now it looks 200% cooler!
[/list][b]Colossus[/b][list]
[*]Has a shadow that can be considered climbable. Do you have the skills?
[/list][b]Disruptor[/b][list]
[*]Disrupts your game's input by adding real-time lag from around the world. Experience up to twelve-hour long delays per action, and really feel like you're traveling the world, one delay at a time!
[/list][b]Engarde![/b][list]
[*]Renamed from Vanguard to Engarde!
[*]Periodically surrounding Defenses to a duel. If it is not destroyed by the end of the duration, it shouts "Engarde!" and stabs the challenged Defenses with a fencing blade, permanently disabling them.
[/list][b]Hoverjet[/b][list]
[*]Now jetpacks over your entire maze to the end. There will be no stopping them.
[/list][b]Infector[/b][list]
[*]Its ability to shut down nearby Defenses has been adjusted to be contagious.
[/list][b]Juggernaut[/b][list]
[*]Now quotes its iconic line when it spawns and when it dies.
[/list][b]Lifter[/b][list]
[*]Now races to the finish against other Axons. Winners proceed to the next race. Losers are yeeted into space.
[/list][b]Linked Squadron[/b][list]
[*]They are now joined at the hip. As a courtesy, please congratulate them before you destroy them.
[/list][b]Mass Cloaker[/b][list]
[*]Goes out of its way to equip all other Axons in range with cloaks, making them 200% cooler. What a nice bot!
[/list][b]Mass Teleporter[/b][list]
[*]See the presentation below.
[/list][b]Overcharge Tank[/b][list]
[*]Now has an actual cannon. Periodically shoots your Defenses with overcharged projectiles, knocking them back by several tiles.
[/list][b]Overprotector[/b][list]
[*]Renamed from Protector to Overprotector.
[*]Gets overprotective about its fellow Axons. Any attempt to intrude further on this will be met with tirades of justice.
[/list][b]Regenerator[/b][list]
[*]No longer has an HP cap. Now regenerates 5% of its Current Max HP per second.
[/list][b]Repairer[/b][list]
[*]Now helps repair your Defenses. Consider keeping one as a pet.
[/list][b]Replicator[/b][list]
[*]Has been upgraded to be capable of manufacturing Tea, Earl Grey, Hot.
[/list][b]Replican't[/b][list]
[*]Renamed from Replicant to Replican't.
[*]It just can't do it anymore, man. It's too much for the poor bot.
[/list][b]Rogue Squadron[/b][list]
[*]Renamed from Squadron to Rogue Squadron.
[*]Does exactly what you think it does. It goes rogue, and it doesn't come back, not even for a modern remaster.
[/list][b]Scarab Lord[/b][list]
[*]No longer has a limit to how many times it can split. Should it eventually shrink small enough to split the atom, it will trigger an atomic detonation.
[/list][b]Scout[/b][list]
[*]Has been given a shotgun, a baseball bat, and can double jump.
[/list][b]Sentinel[/b][list]
[*]No longer takes damage from any source. Not even insults.
[/list][b]Spectre[/b][list]
[*]Now haunts your Defenses after dying by inflicting a permanent Guilt Trip debuff. Defenses that shut down as a result of this should seek therapy.
[/list][b]Speedy Supply Tank[/b][list]
[*]First!
[/list][b]Supply Tank[/b][list]
[*]Now supplies affected Axons with tanks. Lots of them. Tanks will periodically shoot back at your Defenses.
[/list][b]Transport[/b][list]
[*]You can now hire them as shipping services! However, do be aware - they tend to carry maniacal Squadron-type Axons in the back that get rather obsessive over shipped goods.
[/list][b]Teleporter[/b][list]
[*]Has been installed into all standard transportation facilities. Just don't get your atoms mixed with a crate!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/7db09b7c0b72912ed19f7b36404fed59f27b7a91.gif[/img]
[i]Mass Teleporter felt very underwhelming and rarely was a threat. Its AoE and jump distance has been adjusted to compensate.[/i]

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Towers[/b][/h2]

[b]New Tower: An Actual Tree[/b][list]
[*]The game lacked a distinct amount of nature. Now you can plant trees one tower at a time!
[/list][b]Arc Reactor Tower[/b][list]
[*]Now does exactly what it says. What will happen in the next story arc? Gives you play-by-play reactions of every scene, character, and implied moral quandary.
[/list][b]Blast Cannon Tower[/b][list]
[*]Launches itself into space when it fires. This tower is blasting off again!
[/list][b]Bonk Hammer Tower[/b][list]
[*]Renamed from Frag Hammer to Bonk Hammer.
[*]Now makes a "bonk!" sound when it hits Axons, striking them into the ground. They'll need a shovel to get out!
[/list][b]Carolina Reaper Tower[/b][list]
[*]Renamed from Reaper to Carolina Reaper Tower.
[*]Now fires hot sauce beams that scale to millions of scoville units.
[/list][b]Command Link Tower[/b][list]
[*]Towers adjacent to this are now obligated to command the troops. Effective leadership, huh?
[/list][b]Cryobeam & Drilling Laser Towers[/b][list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/a89525af95d54932367d060572152916e0d751a5.jpg[/img]
[*]If you know, you know.
[/list][b]Electron Launcher Tower[/b][list]
[*]Its energy orb now has the properties of an actual Electron. You will never know both its velocity and position.
[/list][b]EMP Gatling Tower[/b][list]
[*]Now fires at a rate of ten thousand rounds per minute. In exchange, it costs four hundred thousand credits to fire this weapon for twelve seconds.
[/list][b]EMP Mine[/b][list]
[*]Now accurately depicts the properties of EMP. When triggered, it permanently shuts down itself and all other Axons and Defenses within range.
[/list][b]Gravity Driver Tower[/b][list]
[*]Renamed from Adam Driver to Gravity Driver.
[*]He needs more power. More! MORE!!!
[/list][b]Gravity Generator Tower[/b][list]
[*]Now turns Axons upside-down. What a cruel joke.
[/list][b]Gravity Trap[/b][list]
[*]No longer slows Axons. Instead, it presents the gravity of the situation in as detailed as a manner as possible. You'll be stuck here all day.
[/list][b]Hide & Seek Drone Tower[/b][list]
[*]Renamed from Seeker Drone to Hide & Seek Drone.
[*]It's already hidden. What do you mean you haven't found it yet?
[/list][b]Inertia Blaster Tower[/b][list]
[*]With each attack, it gains inertia. Should it gain enough inertia, it will exceed the galactic speed limit and transcend reality.
[/list][b]Link Blaster Tower[/b][list]
[*]This defense now does exactly what it says. Upon firing, it destroys a random link from the internet. Sometimes, this hits random fairy boys in green. How does that happen?
[/list][b]Mass Driver Tower[/b][list]
[*]Added recoil. With each shot, it will launch itself backwards by 1 Tile. Should it fall off the map and die, its blood will forever stain your hands. That's on you, man.
[/list][b]Missile Launcher Tower[/b][list]
[*]Were you not paying attention? See the presentation posted at the top.
[/list][b]Nanite Nest Trap[/b][list]
[*]Periodically spawns penguins. They might attach to Axons. Or they might be your front door. Have you checked lately?
[/list][b]Network Tower[/b][list]
[*]Now has Global Range and has made a profile on LinkedIn. It's making new connections faster than ever!
[/list][b]Nuclear Tower[/b][list]
[*]Upon building, effectively nukes everything within a 150 km radius. Look at the bright side, you solved the Axon conflict!
[/list][b]Orbital Cannon Tower[/b][list]
[*]Calls in a true orbital strike from... wait. That's no moon. That's a-
[/list][b]Plasma Cannon Tower[/b][list]
[*]Its plasma properties are now more accurately represented. Upon firing, a hot flash of doom encapsulates everything in the immediate area and vaporizing it all down. This includes Axons, Defenses, the Tiles, and even your mouse cursor.
[/list][b]Plasmathrower Tower[/b][list]
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented this tower from throwing the game. Now comes with a 100% lose rate, guaranteed.
[/list][b]Plasma Seesaw Tower[/b][list]
[*]Renamed from Plasma Saw to Plasma Seesaw.
[*]It now loads Axons into either side, allowing them to play with one another in a safe and sound environment. Well, asides from the plasma sawblades. Be careful with your fingers!
[/list][b]Portable Generator Tower[/b][list]
[*]Now casts its own Overloads at indiscriminate times. Should you be out of Power, it will use any Power source necessary. It's 11PM at night. Is your computer safe?
[/list][b]Proximity Mine[/b][list]
[*]This defense has been diagnosed with anxiety problems and has been removed from the game. Now it's taking a step towards a better- *beep beep*
[/list][b]Pulseray Tower[/b][list]
[*]See the presentation listed somewhere up above.
[/list][b]Radiation Vent Trap[/b][list]
[*]Has been given more ventilation so it can breathe better. Now breathe in clean radioactive air! Wait-
[/list][b]Siphon Cannon Tower[/b][list]
[*]Now siphons damage off your other Defenses, including other Siphon Cannons, and even itself. Upon firing, if its net damage exceeds 100,000, it will create a black hole that enraptures the entire map and game. This is the only way to get the "I beat the game" Achievement.
[/list][b]Sniper Tower[/b][list]
[*]It's retired from professional hunting. Now snipes amazing deals off the internet for you. What a steal!
[/list][b]Target Marker Mine[/b][list]
[*]This defense now does exactly what it says. It will target a marker for you. However, it's up to you to write anything with it. It's not doing the work for you.
[/list][b]Temporal Mine[/b][list]
[*]It sends Axons so far back in time, they end up in a different game. Say, isn't there a patch coming for [b]Element TD 2[/b] in a few months?
[/list][b]Vent Trap[/b][list]
[*]Renamed from Plasma Vent to Vent Trap.
[*]No longer shoots plasma flames. Will now vent at oncoming Axons. Sometimes about its day; other times, it just can't stop yelling. Please be there for your Vent Traps. They just need someone to listen to them.
[/list][b]Waste Thrower Tower[/b][list]
[*]Renamed from Artillery to Waste Thrower Tower.
[*]Launches radioactive waste onto the map itself. Why are you littering so badly?
[/list][b]World Engine Tower[/b][list]
[*]See the presentation listed below.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/e74043e1f4aa3f2e3043d8efd93046bbf5cb2fcf.gif[/img]
[i]For something called World Engine, it didn't really affect the world that much. This is now fixed.[/i]

[hr][/hr]
If you haven't picked up on it by now, this patch isn't real. We wish it was, but sadly, implementing some of these features could breach international law. We can't tell you which ones, so you'll have to speculate.

However, we do invite you to make your own adjustments. Post below what you'd like to see in [b]Axoff TD: Downrising[/b]!

notes.title: State of the Roadmap
notes.content:
Greetings, folks! This is just a little progress update, tellin' ya where we're at, and what's left on our [b]Roadmap[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/c4b90073f42d914525f316373e59db88ad30afae.png[/img]

Earlier this month, we released [b]Version 0.4[/b], our largest update yet. New Defenses, new Axons, Survival Co-op, a massive Campaign update, and more. Basically, everything listed in Q1 2024 above.

As for our next update, unless we split it in half, it should contain everything listed in Q2 2024 above, and more! We're also working on more Tutorials, more Music, more Achievements, and balance as per usual. Speaking of which...

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Update on Balance Updates[/b][/h2]
With our latest additions to the [b]Defense Roster[/b], even after multiple hotfixes, it would appear some our new Defenses still need some tuning. So of course, we're working to address that. Other points include reducing spammability of certain Defenses, and... counters against [b]Shields[/b].

Of every mechanic in the game, [b]Shields[/b] is the hardest counter. You either have stuff that can remove it easily... or half your defense gets negated and you die. We're looking into adjusting this so it's still something you have to look out for and plan around, just not to as insane a degree.

Beyond that, we're adjusting a bunch of [b]Techs[/b] to be less abusable (ie, conditionals that are too easy to proc), and buffing ones that are hard to use.

[hr][/hr]
In a nutshell, we're still on track to hit our [b]Roadmap[/b] goals. Next week or so, we'll finally show off a long awaited teaser of our [u]map editor[/u], so look forward to that!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/238d4d714ef87a998af48752387ff6d950480599.gif[/img]
[i]This looks totally balanced.[/i]

notes.title: Version 0.4.4 - RIP Electron Launcher TD
notes.content:
[h2][b]Balance[/b][/h2][list]
[*]Electron Launcher's Global Upgrade no longer counts other Electron Launchers towards extending its range.[list]
[*]As a result of this change, all [b]Survival Leaderboard Entries[/b] that made use of this particular abuse have been wiped. We apologize once again for the inconvenience. [i]Hopefully[/i] this is the last one until [b]Version 0.5[/b].
[*]Also, if you were suffering from extreme lag by spamming this tower, you should no longer suffer the same lag as it can no longer be stacked like it could before.
[/list][/list]

[h2][b]Fixes[/b][/h2][list]
[*]Fixed an issue in Co-op Survival that would cause the game to crash after Wave 60.[list]
[*]Also as a result of [i]this fix[/i], all [b]Co-op Survival Leaderboard Entries[/b] are wiped, as this invalidates past replays.
[/list][*]Fixed the game mysteriously freezing when hovering over the Next Expand button in Survival from Wave 100 onwards.
[*]Fixed Tread Lightly Meta Tech tooltip, it is not supposed to apply its 10% Slow to Traps, only to Mines.
[*]Fixed "+1 Recycle when affecting 15 Axons with an Overload" being able to trigger more than once per wave.
[*]Attempted another fix for "Recycle on Obstacles" Tech not working properly.
[*]If for whatever reason you had Negative Tech Points in the Survival Meta Tech Tree, you should now be at 0 Points, and you should no longer be locked out of progressing.
[*]Adjusted the Replay UI to be less bulky.
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/872722666cce3692208cbf95cdbaf27977b91992.gif[/img]
[i]RIP Electron Launcher abuse. You will be missed... and so will your extreme lag.[/i]

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Version 0.4.5 Fixes[/b][/h2]
We got a new version up with a few more fixes. Here they are:[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where playing Co-op Survival would delete your single player Survival checkpoints.
[*]Fixed an issue where Co-op Survival replays could not be viewed.
[*]There's now a button to toggle Co-op notifications in the Co-op Menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.4.2 & 0.4.3 Hotfix
notes.content:
[h2][b]Fixes[/b][/h2][list]
[*]Fixed Survival going beyond Wave 120
[*]Fixed an interaction between Siphon Cannon U3 & Gravity Generator U2 resulting in dealing waaaay more damage than intended.
-- This interaction with Colossus was resulting in serious lag spikes. That should no longer occur.
[*]Fixed a range detection issue with Siphon Cannon U3, also resulting in it dealing more damage than intended.
[*]Fixed Target Marker refreshing its duration if multiple are placed in a row (meaning you no longer get super stacked damage explosions).
[*]Fixed Temporal Mine's AoE Teleport being able to teleport Bosses or Axons with Temporal Mine immunity.
[*]Fixed Disruptor's attack rate debuff lingering even if the Disruptor itself dies
[*]Fixed Gravity Generator U2 visually showing a slowing field around itself (it only slows around connected towers)
[*]Fixed Portable Generator sometimes not displaying its green dots
[*]Fixed Electron Launcher's orb sometimes getting stuck
[*]Fixed a NullRef error that can occur after finishing Missions 23 and/or 24
[*]Fixed an error that could freeze the game by right-clicking a portal in Co-op
[*]Fixed an error that could occur by placing a Tower
[*]Fixed Same Tower Cost Reduction 
[*]Fixed Tutorial 5 giving you EMP Mine instead of the intended Inertia Blaster
[/list]

[h2][b]Balance[/b][/h2][list]
[*][b]Purger[/b]:
-- HP reduced from 120 to 110
-- Cleanse ability cooldown increased from 7s to 8s
-- In Survival, removed many instances where Purger was both Armored & Shielded. This should help reduce its effectiveness as a hard counter to the debuff dependent builds out there.
[*][b]Guardian Boss (Survival)[/b]:
-- HP increased by 25% per stage
-- Movespeed reduced by 50%
-- This change was made to adjust the Guardian Boss to fill more of a supportive role.
[/list]
Lastly, more [b]Codex[/b] entries in the [b]Campaign[/b] have been filled in.

As a result of these changes, all [b]Leaderboards[/b] have been reset.

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Version 0.4.3 Fixes[/b][/h2][list]
[*]Fixed Gravity Generator with the Global Upgrade dealing 4 damage per frame instead of per second. Any Leaderboard entry making use of this abuse has been nuked, which is basically the top entries in Survival.
[*]Fixed Nuclear Blockers Tech not dealing damage.
[*]Fixed Astrosys' Build on Empty Tile Tech not removing the Survival Fill-in Tile
[*]Fixed Esc not working on the Codex screen
[*]Made some minor tweaks to dialogue and tooltips
[*]Replay UI has been updated:
 -- All controls have been moved to the right side
 -- You can now see the player's UI and techs properly
[/list]
[hr][/hr]

That's it for [b]Versions 0.4.2 & 0.4.3[/b]! We still have a few lingering issues to tackle for a potential 0.4.4:[list]
[*]There's a rare occurrence in Co-op Survival where the game can crash. We're looking into it.
[*]There's also an error in Survival where hovering over "Next Expand" can freeze the game. Only happens if you're far enough into the game. Supposedly Wave 99+
[*][strike]The Nuclear Blockers tech (the one that gives your Blockers a 3x3 DoT) is currently not working.[/strike]
[*][strike]Various typos and awkward wording in tooltips around the place.[/strike]
[*]Ambience cutting out when there's too many sounds going on.
[*]Possibly some nerfs to certain Campaign missions.
[/list]
And that's it! We're almost done cleaning up [b]Version 0.4[/b]. In the meantime, we're quietly hacking away at the next big version. Expect a teaser for it within the next month!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/57e854b02cadadecb1371372368d5424c15f68d0.gif[/img]
[i]RIP this bugged, OP setup.[/i]

notes.title: Version 0.4.1 Hotfix
notes.content:
[h3][b]Campaign[/b][/h3][list]
[*]Added a [b]Reset Campaign[/b] button. You can find this at the bottom of [b]Gameplay Settings[/b].
[*]Fixed Mission 13: Connections being unplayable.
[*]Fixed the Challenge on Mission 24: A Way Out not working.
[*]Fixed Challenges breaking after loading a checkpoint
[*]Fixed an abuse that allowed you to drag locked Defenses into the Loadout.
[/list]

[h3][b]Quality of Life[/b][/h3][list]
[*]Added a [b]Clear Obsolete Replays[/b] button. This wipes out all your stored replays except from the current version.
[*]Hosting a Co-op Survival game will now trigger a Join Game Notification in the Menu (for those with Game Notifications on).
[*]Updated the Loading Screen with more images
[/list]

[h3][b]Fixes[/b][/h3][list]
[*]Fixed being unable to join a Co-op game via Invite.
[*]Fixed Loadout submission and display for Leaderboard.
[*]Fixed Nanite Nest Drones remaining attached to a Boss between waves, allowing them to continue dealing damage.
[*]Fixed Zeus Cannon Overload Ability throwing an error if there's no target
[*]Fixed loading a checkpoint in Survival sometimes giving an extra Expansion
[*]Fixed numerous tower upgrades having incorrect VFX. Or in the case of Link Blaster U3, completely missing.

We hope this addresses most of the immediate concerns with [b]Version 0.4's[/b] release. We are aware this is not all of the bugs. notes.title: Version 0.4 - New Defenses, Co-op Survival, Chapter 3
notes.content:
Almost three months later, and [b]Version 0.4[/b], our most expansive content update, is finally released! New Defenses, New Axons, Co-op Survival, Chapter 3 and updates to the Campaign, improved performance, some much requested QoL features, updated balance, fixes, and more!

In fact, like we did with 0.2, we've got a handy dandy video that shows off all the major features. Check it out!

[previewyoutube=f4SktuwPUNw;full][/previewyoutube]

And now, for yet another giant changelog of doom, behold: endless scrolling.

[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]General[/b][/h1]
- Major performance optimizations have been made.
- Campaign and Survival save systems have been overhauled to be less error prone and to better prepare for future additions. Please report any issues to us!
- Hard Difficulty is now a 25% HP increase, up from 20%. 
- There's now a popup for when a Meta Tech triggers.
- You can no longer change the timescale in between waves, it automatically resets to x1 during wave breaks, and reverts to what you had it on when you start the wave again. 
- You can now hover over your Credits and Power to see how much you've gotten from different sources.

[h2][b]Campaign[/b][/h2]
- Chapter 3 of the Campaign has been added!
- Chapters 1 & 2 have been revised both in story and gameplay. Go replay those missions!
- Some of the levels in each chapter now have challenges in them, marked by a green star, granting an extra tech tree point when completed. 
- The Tech Tree has been reworked to be a bit more straightforward. 
- Your Defense Upgrades are now directly tied to your progress on the Campaign Map. 
- Added the Journal! This is a place to see notes from Patricia and Omni to offer more context as you progress through the story. 
- Patricia now has a few different expressions. 

[h2][b]Quickplay[/b][/h2]
- Just about every single map has had their wave compositions adjusted for the updated balance sandbox. 
- Added one more wave to [b]Isolation[/b].
- Slightly adjusted the map layout for [b]Matrix[/b].
- Adjusted resource scaling on [b]Comms Centre[/b].
- Added two more waves to [b]Relic[/b].  
- Added three more waves to [b]Arrival[/b].
- Added one more wave to [b]Duality[/b].
- Updated the map layout for [b]Foundry07[/b] and added two more waves.
- Updated the map layout for [b]Lost Sectors[/b] and added two more waves. 

[h2][b]Survival[/b][/h2]
- You now need to place down an Expand before you start the next wave. 
- The Survival Upgrade icons have been updated with a cleaner style. 

[h2][b]Co-op[/b][/h2]
- [b]Survival Co-op[/b] has been added with its own leaderboard!
- You can now fast-forward at x2 in Co-op any time you want during the waves!
- Added notifications for when someone sends you Credits or Power.
- You can now see which map category the host has selected in the Co-op lobby. 
- Map wave counts is now displayed in the Co-op lobby. 
- Just about every map has had their wave compositions adjusted for the updated balance sandbox. 
- Added three more waves to [b]Redirection[/b]. 
- Updated the map layout for [b]Overlap[/b]. 

[h2][b]Achievements[/b][/h2]
- Added 16 new achievements!
 -- [b]You Know Nothing[/b] | Complete the Tutorial. 
 -- [b]Learning from the Best[/b] | Watch a Replay from the Leaderboards. 
 -- [b]Look Ma![/b] | Place in the top 25 on any Leaderboard. 
 -- [b]Isolated the Problem[/b] | Complete the Quickplay map "Isolation" on Hard difficulty. 
 -- [b]Broke the Code[/b] | Complete the Quickplay map "Matrix" with a path length of at least 120. 
 -- [b]Iconic[/b] | Complete the Quickplay map "Relic" with a score of at least 18000. 
 -- [b]Going it Alone[/b] | Complete a Co-op map Solo on Normal difficulty. 
 -- [b]Don't Need Your Help[/b] | Complete a Co-op map Solo on Hard difficulty. 
 -- [b]No Going Back[/b] | Complete Chapter 3 of the Campaign. 
 -- [b]"All Decked Out[/b] | Spend 540 Upgrade Points in the Survival Upgrade Tree. 
 -- [b]Seen it All[/b] | Beat wave 66 in any Survival map on any difficulty. 
 -- [b]We live[/b] | Finish wave 30 of Co-op Survival on Normal difficulty. 
 -- [b]We really lived![/b] | Finish wave 30 of Co-op Survival on Hard difficulty. 
 -- [b]Epic Survivor: Blank Canvas[/b] | Finish wave 30 of Survival Blank Canvas on Hard difficulty. 
 -- [b]Survivor: Islands[/b] | Finish wave 30 of Survival Islands on Normal difficulty.
 -- [b]Epic Survivor: Islands[/b] | Finish wave 30 of Survival Islands on Hard difficulty.
- Your achievements now level you up. This level is displayed in Co-op lobbies as a prestige number. 
- Fixed multiple bugs preventing achievements from being completed and reduced some of the requirements to make them less grindy.

[h2][b]Audio[/b][/h2]
- 2 new music tracks have been added to the game. 
- Upgrades are now a 3D sound, meaning you can't hear them from across the map in Co-op.
- Added ambience tracks to several of the biomes. 
- Removed sirens from certain ambiences
- Lowered the volume on certain ambiences

[h2][b]Visuals[/b][/h2]
- Icons have been updated across the game. No more placeholders!
- Added a Shield Hit visual
- EMP Lightning Tech now has a visual
- Updated the VFX for EMP effects, including EMP Gatling, EMP Mine, Gravity Generator U1, and EMP Blast Overload
- Blast Cannon VFX is a bit snappier, and the projectiles no longer phase through certain Axons
- Various VFX cleanup, should be slightly more performant and have less clutter
- Added more variations to the various biomes. As a result, every Mission in Campaign now has a unique background.
- Shields & Armor now consistently show up on all Axons. Previously, there were cases it didn't show up properly.
- Adjusted the scale of Shields on some Axons, should look a little less cluttered

[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]New Defense and Axon Additions[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]Added 4 New Defenses[/b][/h2]
[b]Siphon Cannon[/b], a new MegaCorp Tower:  
- [b]Cost[/b]: 125.
- [b]Damage[/b]: 175. 
- [b]Range[/b]: Global. 
- [b]Cooldown[/b]: 20 seconds. 
- [b]Effect[/b]: Emits a siphoning field. Each Axon within the field reduces its cooldown every second. 
 -- [b]Upgrade 1[/b]: Each Axon within the field adds 3 damage to the main cannon. 
 -- [b]Upgrade 2[/b]: Slows Axons within the Siphoning Field by 10%. 
 -- [b]Upgrade 3[/b]: The Siphoning Field now deals 3 damage per second to all Axons within its field. 
 -- [b]Global Upgrade: [/b]Increases the AoE of the Siphoning Field by 0.5.

[b]Nanite Nest[/b], a new Vex Industries Trap: 
- [b]Cost[/b]: 100
- [b]Drone Damage[/b]: 3. 
- [b]Range[/b]: 1.
- [b]Drone Range[/b]: 2.5.
- [b]Cooldown[/b]: 1.
- [b]Effect[/b]: 2 Nanite Drones reside within this Trap. They attach to passing Axons and deal damage over time. If the Axon has Armor or Shields, they are removed while the Nanite Drone is attached to it. Only one Nanite Drone can be attached on each Axon. When the target dies, it finds a new target within its range or returns to the trap. 
 -- [b]Upgrade 1[/b]: The target is slowed by 20%. 
 -- [b]Upgrade 2[/b]: Adds another Nanite Drone. 
 -- [b]Upgrade 3[/b]: Each Nanite Drone also deals 4 damage within 2 AoE of the target it is attached to every 3 seconds. 
 -- [b]Global Upgrade[/b]: Applies a 30% Damage Amp for 6 seconds to its target each time it jumps to a new Axon. 

[b]Electron Launcher[/b], a new Astrosys Labs Tower: 
- [b]Cost[/b]: 125.
- [b]Damage[/b]: 9 per second. 
- [b]Damage Buff[/b]: 20% for 3 seconds.
- [b]AoE[/b]: 1x5. 
- [b]Cooldown[/b]: 6. 
- [b]Effect[/b]: Directional. Fires an energy orb in a straight line. Damages hostiles and empowers allied Defenses it passes through. 
 -- [b]Upgrade 1[/b]: Increases damage per second. 
 -- [b]Upgrade 2[/b]: Reduced damage. Applies a 1 second EMP to Axons it passes over. 
 -- [b]Upgrade 3[/b]: Extends the duration of the damage buff on allied Defenses from 3 to 5 seconds.  
 -- [b]Global Upgrade[/b]: Increases range by 1 tile for each Tower the energy orb passes through. 

[b]Plasma Saw[/b], a new New Fronter Tower: 
- [b]Cost[/b]: 100.
- [b]Damage[/b]: 5/7/9. 
- [b]AoE[/b]: 3x3. 
- [b]Cooldown[/b]: 1. 
- [b]Effect[/b]: Deals continuous plasma damage to Axons within its AoE. Every 3.5 seconds of continuously being active, it reaches a new damage stage, increasing its damage by 2. Maxes out at the third stage. Every 2 seconds of inactivity slows it down again. 
 -- [b]Upgrade 1[/b]: Adds another damage stage. 
 -- [b]Upgrade 2[/b]: No longer deals plasma damage, cooldown reduced to 0.7. 
 -- [b]Upgrade 3[/b]: Reduced base damage. Applies a 20% damage amp to all Axons within its AoE. 
 -- [b]Global Upgrade[/b]:  Adds another damage stage. 

[h2][b]5 New Axons[/b][/h2]
[b]Spectre[/b]
- [b]HP[/b]: 80.
- [b]Move speed[/b]: 1.2 (Standard).
- [b]Effect[/b]: Reassembles itself on death after 3 seconds, with 75% of its Max HP.  

[b]Lifter[/b]
- [b]HP[/b]: 140.
- [b]Move speed[/b]: 1.8.
- [b]Effect[/b]: Is Debuff immune. Picks up the first Axon it passes and brings it along with it at its own speed. During this time, the carried Axon cannot be damaged, but continues to cast its abilities. 

[b]Disruptor[/b]
- [b]HP[/b]: 160. 
- [b]Move speed[/b]: 1.7 / 0.
- [b]Effect[/b]: Has two modes. Switches mode every 7 seconds.  
 -- Mobile mode: Moves faster and takes 25% reduced damage. 
 -- Stationary mode: Stops moving and raises itself up above the platform on its long legs, reducing the attack speed of all Defenses within 3 AoE by 25%. 

[b]Vanguard[/b]
- [b]HP[/b]: 250. 
- [b]Move speed[/b]: 1.2 (Standard).
- [b]Effect[/b]: Taunts Defenses within 5 range to attack it for 6 seconds. Ends if the Vanguard goes out of range. Cooldown of 10 seconds.

[b]Guardian (New Boss)[/b]
- [b]Base HP[/b]: 700 
- [b]Base move speed[/b]: 0.7/0.6/0.5.
- [b]Effect[/b]: On each stage transition, it drops a protective field behind it that persist through waves until it dies. The Boss and Axons within it take 30% reduced damage.

[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Balance[/b][/h1]
[h2][b]Survival[/b][/h2]
- Reduced the resource caps of end of wave rewards. The caps are now 100 Credits, 45 Power, 5 ADDs and 3 Recycles. 
- Reduced Credits per wave from Axons between waves 1-10 from 50 to 40, and waves 30+ from 100 to 90. 
- Fixed an issue where you occasionally got disproportionate amounts of Blockers with the ADDs choice. 
- Increased the amount of early ADDs from end of wave rewards early to better match the other rewards. 
- Reduced the scaling of some of the Techs in Survival specifically since there's way more waves. 
- Reduced the spawn time of Waves 1 to 30 significantly and tweaked just about every wave. Overall, it should be easier and faster to clear wave 30.
- Reduced the spawn time of all the endless waves by about 5-10 seconds each, in some cases more. 
- Rescaled the HP multiplier of Survival across the board, making it easier to break into the 40s, but harder to go past 60. 
[i]It is our continued goal to get more builds into the 60s and 70s, and at the same time hit the outliers that go way past.[/i]
- Reduced the number of Armored and Shielded support Axons in the endless waves, making it easier for most builds to deal with them. 

[h2][b]Axons[/b][/h2]
[b]Colossus[/b]
- HP reduced from 400 to 375. 

[b]Mass Cloaker[/b]
- HP increased from 130 to 140. 

[b]Scout[/b]
- HP increased from 40 to 45. 

[b]Purger[/b]
- Range decreased from 4 to 3. 
- Cooldown increased from 6s to 7s.  

[b]Squadron[/b]
- HP per unit increased from 20 to 27. 

- [b]Warden[/b] Boss has been renamed to [b]Revenant[/b], and now serves more as a support cloaker than something that would actually leak in Survival. Moves slower but has more HP. 


[h2][b]Defenses[/b][/h2]
[b]Arc Reactor[/b]
- Attacks now apply a debuff to Axons that reduces healing from all sources by 25% for 6 seconds. 
- Damage reduction per bounce reduced from 15% to 10%. (U3 unaffected). 
- Base damage increased from 16 to 18. 
- U3 base damage increased from 7 to 9. 

[b]Artillery[/b]
- Base Impact Damage increased from 7 to 8. 
- Global Upgrade range bonus reduced from +2 to +1. 

[b]Blast Cannon[/b]
- Base damage from 14 to 12
- Cooldown reduced from 2s to 1.7s.
- U1 and U3 have been flipped. 
- U1 no longer increases AoE, instead increases range.
- U1 damage cap reduced from 100% to 70%.  
- U3 damage per stack reduced from 6 to 5, and explosions no longer ignore Armor with the Global Upgrade. 

[b]Drilling Laser[/b]
- Base damage increased from 6 to 8. 
- U1 base damage increased from 8 to 10.
- U2 slow increased from 30% to 40%. 
- Damage cap increased from 24 to 26.  

[b]EMP Gatling[/b]
- Damage increased from 1 to 2. 

[b]EMP Mine[/b]
- Cooldown increased from 15s to 20s. 
- U1 Cooldown increased from 10s to 15s. 

[b]Frag Hammer[/b]
- Damage increased from 55/27 to 90/45
- Axons hit in the primary tile now always get stunned for 0.7 seconds. 
- Cooldown increased from 3.5 seconds to 4 seconds. 
- U1 replaced: 
 -- Old: Deals triple damage if there's 2 or less Axons hit.
 -- New: Side tile damage increased from 50% to 75%.
- U2 replaced and Power cost reduced from 35 to 30: 
 -- Old: Stuns all targets hit for 0.6 seconds.
 -- New U2: If it hits a single Axon, reduce the cooldown of the next attack by 2 seconds.
- Global Upgrade replaced: 
 -- Old: +10 Damage. In addition, +10% attack speed if there are no adjacent Defenses.
 -- New: Deals 50% increased damage when hitting an Armored Axon.

[b]Gravity Driver[/b]
- Base range increased by 1 (U3 unaffected). 
- U1 damage increased from 3 to 4. 
- Global Upgrade threshold increased from 80% to 70%, and the bonus slow has been increased from 10% to 15%. 

[b]Gravity Trap[/b]
- Global Upgrade slow reduced from 40% to 30%. 
- U3 cooldown increased from 10 to 15. 

[b]Inertia Blaster[/b]
- U2 damage cap increased from 45 to 55. 

[b]Link Blaster[/b]
- Damage reduced from 12 to 10. 
- Cooldown increased from 1.2 to 1.5.
- U3 damage reduced from 16 to 12. 

[b]Mass Driver[/b]
- Base range increased by 1. 
- Base damage increased from 55 to 60. 
- U3 damage increased from 40 to 45.

[b]Orbital Cannon[/b]
- Base damage increased from 24 to 26. 
- U2 damage increased from 30 to 32. 
- U3 replaced: This tower and towers adjacent to it ignore Shields.

[b]Plasma Cannon[/b]
- U1 DoT damage increased from 16 over 8 seconds, to 18 over 6 seconds. 
- U2 EMP cooldown decreased from 8 to 6 seconds, and duration reduced from 6 seconds to 4 seconds. 
- Global Upgrade bounce cooldown decreased from 8 to 6 seconds.

[b]Plasmathrower[/b]
- Damage increased from 6 to 12. 
- Cooldown increased from 0.5 to 1. 
- U1 bonus Fire Arc removed. 
- U2 Damage per second increased from 5 over 5 seconds to 8 over 4 seconds. 
- U3 damage reduced from 12 to 10. 

[b]Plasma Vent[/b]
- U1 DoT increased from 6 over 3 seconds to 8 over 4 seconds.

[b]Portable Generator[/b]
- Credit cost increased from 30 to 40. 
- U1 cap per wave reduced from 20 to 10. 
- Global Upgrade damage bonus reduced from 30% to 25%. 

[b]Proximity Mine[/b]
- U2 Damage reduced from 120 to 110, and AoE reduced from 0.6 to 0.4.

[b]Pulseray[/b]
- Cooldown reduced from 1.5s to 1.4s
- U1 Damage increased from 12 to 13. 
- U1 Cap attack speed cap decreased from 0.25 to 0.4.
- U2 replaced: 
 -- Now applies a 100% Damage Amp on an Axon until it gets hit again by anything that deals more than 10 damage.
- U3 cooldown increased from 1.4 to 2 seconds. 
- U3 bonus damage increased from 32 to 48. 

[b]Radiation Vent[/b]
- Base damage increased from 20 damage over 10 seconds, to 24 damage over 8 seconds. 
- U2 Damage per second increased from 6 to 8 and duration increased from 5 to 6 seconds.

[b]Seeker Drone[/b]
- U3 Damage reduced from 6 to 5.

[b]Sniper[/b]
- Base damage increased by 5. 
- Now ignores Armor by default.
- Global Upgrade damage bonus increased from +5 to +10. 

[b]Target Marker[/b]
- U2 percentage damage increased from 60% to 120%. 

[b]Temporal Mine[/b]
- No longer works on Bosses.

[b]World Engine[/b]
- Range Damage tiers now scale with Range buffs. 
- Base damage increased from 11 to 14.
- U3 damage increased from 9 to 11.  
- U1 Slow reduced from 40% to 20%, and duration increased from 1.5 to 3 seconds.
- Global Upgrade replaced: Now unleashes a second shockwave every 3 hits that deals 6 damage in 3 AoE.

[b]Techs[/b]
- "Recycle Over Time" wave count reduced from 5 to 4, and minimum wave set to 10 in Survival. 
- "Power on Build" Power bonus increased from 2 to 3. 
- "ADDs on Wave End" reduced from 2 every 3 waves to 1 every 2 waves in Survival. 
- "Blockers on Wave End" reduced from 2 every 3 waves to 1 every 2 waves in Survival.
- "Recycles on Wave End" reduced from 1 every 3 waves to 1 every 4 waves in Survival. 
- "Sells on Wave End" reduced from 2 every 2 waves to 1 every 2 waves in Survival. 
-  "Foundation Tile" discount reduced from 15 to 10. 
- "Astrosys ADD under Towers" Power cost reduced from 10 to 5. 
- "Resource Package" ADD reward reduced from 4 to 3. 
- "Path reward Credits" Credits bonus reduced from 5 to 2 to match up with the value of its power equivalent. 
- The Manufacturer Techs requiring a % of Defenses from a specific manufacturer on the field now won't show up unless you have two of that manufacturer in your loadout. 
- Reduced the Meta Tech "Expansionist" from a 10 Credit reduction to 8. 
- Reduced the Meta Tech "Mad Science" from a 5 Power reduction to 4.

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Miscellaneous Fixes[/b][/h2]
- Fixed an issue where Axons that are spawned or split from other Axons didn't have Armor or Shields if the "parent" had it. 
- Fixed an issue where you got too much Credits from various sources. 
- Fixed an issue where sending more than certain amounts of Credits or Power per wave to another player in Co-op causes some resources to disappear.  
- Fixed multiple causes of desync, both in replay and in Co-op. 
- Fixed an issue where a cap was applied incorrectly if you were playing Co-op solo. 
- Fixed an issue where Stasis wave permanently froze some Axons, and in some cases, caused Desyncs in Co-op. 
- Fixed an issue where Blast Cannon projectiles weren't clearing properly.
- Fixed an issue where the Mass Driver didn't refresh when you removed an Obstacle. 
- Fixed an issue where trying to place a Defense towards the outer bounds of a map would throw an error. 
- Fixed an issue with the "Mega Expansionist" Meta Tech resulting in getting more discounts than intended.
- Fixed an issue where the "Less Obstacles" Meta Tech gave a walkable tile in the place of the removed Obstacle rather than an empty tile. 
- Fixed an issue where the free Global Upgrade recieved from the "Locked In" Meta Tech didn't appear as unlocked in the UI. 
- Fixed an issue where the "Path Power Reward" Tech gave Credits instead of Power. 
- Fixed an issue where the "Nuclear Blocker" tech wasn't always detecting nearby Axons. 
- Fixed an issue on the Quickplay map [b]Foundry07[/b] where tiles that were supposed to be unlocked weren't. 
- Cleaned up multiple tooltips and fixed some errors.

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]How to Reset Campaign Progress[/b][/h2]
If you're interested in redoing the [b]Campaign[/b] from scratch to experience the updated story and gameplay revisions, it's quite simple! First, go to this file location:

[code]C:\Users\%username%\AppData\LocalLow\Element Studios\Axon TD_ Uprising[/code]
Find the file [u]CamProg.save[/u], and remove it. There you go, progress reset! Again, this isn't mandatory. It's just you might be a little confused if you simply continue from where you left off.

[hr][/hr]
Congratulations, you've reached the end of the post! As usual, [b]Leaderboards[/b] have been reset. If you want other players to try [b]Co-op Survival[/b] with, tag yourself in #roles with @LFG-Axon, and ask away.

We hope you enjoy trying out the new Defenses and the many strategies they've opened up, as well as everything else in the game!

notes.title: 0.4 Preview - Campaign Revision
notes.content:
March is here, and that means [b]Version 0.4[/b] is around the corner! Today, we have a preview of the [b]Campaign Revision[/b].

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]New Characters[/b][/h2]
The core plot remains the same - you're stranded on the planet, you're fighting Axons, and there's some illegal mining operation going on that seems vaguely relevant. However, many of the surrounding details have been overhauled.

For starters, there's more characters. And we're not just talking [b]Chapter 3[/b]. This, for example, takes place in the updated [b]Mission 4[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/5f466c37ef7e12c55885edc9b7a1f78551bc80c5.png[/img][i]Ignore the Dev overrides in the corner, they are not part of the story... yet.[/i]

Nearly the whole script has been rewritten or touched upon in some form.

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Gameplay Updates[/b][/h2]
Every existing mission has received revisions or complete overhauls. Certain mechanics have been reordered. For example:[list]
[*]Credit Generators happen way sooner
[*]Axons start gaining [b]Armor[/b] in [b]Chapter 2[/b]
[*]Axons start gaining [b]Shields[/b] in [b]Chapter 3[/b]
[*]Multi-path missions are far more frequent, but don't worry; we ease you into it.
[/list]
[b]Prebuilt Defenses[/b] on nearly every mission are now activated by default. Every mission is 1 or 2 Waves longer. [b]Bosses[/b] will spawn in the latter half of the mission instead of early on, giving you a chance to actually build up.

And [b]Mission 15[/b] no longer requires combining the paths to win:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/fa6b9ffb1c7115c1af361eec51ed2820df723f65.jpg[/img][i]This is a little different than I remember...[/i]

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Tech Tree[/b][/h2]
Progression-wise, the order you unlock [b]Defenses[/b] has changed. For those of you that got annoyed by having to constantly redo your [b]Defense Upgrades[/b] because you changed your active [b]Loadout[/b], that menu has been done away with. You will now unlock them in batches:[list]
[*]U1 is available by default
[*]U2 is unlocked after beating [b]Chapter 1[/b]
[*]U3 is unlocked after beating [b]Chapter 2[/b]
[*]Global Upgrade is unlocked after beating [b]Chapter 3[/b]
[/list]
As for the [b]Tech Tree[/b], that's received a much needed overhaul:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/24fb9252b17eb476369b32c00ad0066607ae400d.jpg[/img][i]It's actually readable![/i]

Additionally, certain missions have [b]Challenges[/b]. These are optional objectives that, when cleared, provide you with [b]1 Extra Tech Point[/b] for the [b]Tech Tree[/b]. Early ones aren't too difficult, but later ones, well... good luck!

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Do I have to restart my progress?[/b][/h2]
Short answer, no. If you don't want to replay the existing Campaign, you do not have to (with the exception of backtracking for [b]Challenges[/b]). You will notice that your [b]Loadout[/b] has different defenses, you'll have to reassign your [b]Tech Tree[/b], and you may be confused by the new characters, updated progression, order of mechanics, etc.

If you want to reset your progress and experience the [b]Campaign Revision[/b] from scratch, we will offer a way to do so. But we won't force this. You are welcome to continue without replaying [b]Chapters 1 & 2[/b].

[hr][/hr]
There's a few other little additions for the [b]Campaign[/b]. For example, [b]Patricia & Omni[/b] have expressions (we plan on adding more to other characters down the road). There's a [b]Journal[/b], containing extra info about the world as well as personal logs.

Oh, and of course, [b]Chapter 3[/b] will arrive with [b]9 New Missions[/b]!

Look forward to the updated [b]Campaign[/b] and more next week, when [b]Version 0.4[/b] releases on [b]Friday, March 8th[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/3030728add9c25a82d1262ec4246362208862171.gif[/img]
[i]A new Axon carries its allies forward. Coming in [b]Version 0.4[/b]![/i]

In a few minutes here, we're starting up a [b]Dev Stream[/b] showing off the new [b]Survival Co-op Mode[/b]. Stop on by and check it out! Feel free to ask questions in the chat as well.
